aerobics.cn: 我想参加有氧运动训练班来增强体质。

aerobics.en: Unlike aerobics, walking entails no expensive fees for classes or clubs.
aerobics.cn: 散步不像有氧健身操那样需要交纳昂贵的费用来参加健身班或俱乐部。

aerodynamic.en: The secret of the machine lies in the aerodynamic shape of the frame.
aerodynamic.cn: 该机器的精妙之处在于其构架呈流线型。

aerodynamic.en: Aerodynamic forces and moments are strictly speaking functionals of the state variables.
aerodynamic.cn: 严格说来,气动力和力矩是状态变量的泛涵.

aerodynamic.en: These effects appear to be negligible with respect to aerodynamic coefficients.
aerodynamic.cn: 就空气动力系数这方面来说,这些影响似乎可以略去.

aeroplane.en: The centre of pressure moves rearward and the aeroplane becomes unbalanced.
aeroplane.cn: 气压中心后移使飞机失去平衡。

aeroplane.en: The aeroplane was gyrating about the sky in a most unpleasant fashion.
aeroplane.cn: 飞机在空中盘旋，令人不堪忍受。

aeroplane.en: I didn't get a wink of sleep on the aeroplane.
aeroplane.cn: 我在飞机上没合一下眼。

aerospace.en: British Aerospace has won an order worth 340 million dollars.
aerospace.cn: 英国宇航公司已经赢得了3.4亿美元的订单。

aerospace.en: Shortly afterwards, cuts in defence spending forced the aerospace industry to retrench.
aerospace.cn: 不久之后，国防开支的削减迫使航空航天业紧缩开支。

aerospace.en: The American aerospace industry has been challenged by some stiff competition.
aerospace.cn: 美国航空和航天工业已经受到某种强劲的竞争产品的挑战。

aesthetic.en: an aesthetic appreciation of the landscape
aesthetic.cn: 用审美的眼光欣赏风景

aesthetic.en: From an aesthetic point of view it's a thetic view.
aesthetic.cn: 从美学观点来说,这是个武断的看法.

aesthetic.en: He responded very strongly to the aesthetic of this particular work.
aesthetic.cn: 他强烈地感受到这件作品的美学价值。

aesthetically.en: All isolation techniques may be aesthetically unacceptable or even dirty.
aesthetically.cn: 所有的隔离方法都有可能在美观方面使人难以接受,或甚至是肮脏的.

aesthetically.en: It aims to identify the characteristic value of aesthetically satisfying objects.
aesthetically.cn: 它的目的在于鉴别审美快感的物体所特有的价值.

aesthetically.en: Segmental construction contributes toward aesthetically pleasing structures in many different sites.
aesthetically.cn: 对于许多不同的现场条件,分段施工都能提供美观,颇有魄力的桥型结构.

afar.en: Seen from afar, its towering buildings beckon the visitor in.
afar.cn: 从远处看，它高耸的大楼召唤着拜访者进去。

afar.en: Is it not delightful to have friends coming from afar?
afar.cn: 有朋自远方来,不亦乐乎?

afar.en: A bosom friend afar brings a distant land near.
afar.cn: 海内存知己,天涯若比邻.

affable.en: Murray was an affable, free-spirited man.
affable.cn: 默里是个温和友善、无拘无束的人。

affable.en: Mr Brooke is an extremely affable and approachable man.
affable.cn: 布鲁克先生极为谦和，平易近人。

affable.en: Forrest was normally mild-mannered, affable, and untalkative.
affable.cn: 福里斯特通常态度温和、待人亲切、少言寡语。

affair.en: "This ain't no affair of yours, boy!" McClosky said threateningly.
affair.cn: “小子，这不关你的事！”麦克洛斯基威胁道。

affair.en: He claims he was made the fall guy for the affair.
affair.cn: 他声称自己是这起事件的替罪羊。

affair.en: He will now face a disciplinary hearing for having an affair.
affair.cn: 他因有外遇而要面临纪律听证会的裁决。

affect.en: Poor housing and family stress can affect both physical and mental health.
affect.cn: 住房条件差、家庭压力大会影响身心两方面的健康。

affect.en: Scientists call this the "it won't affect me" syndrome.
affect.cn: 科学家把这种现象称为“我无所谓”的典型表现。

affect.en: Price changes must not adversely affect the living standards of the people.
affect.cn: 物价变化一定不能给人们的生活水准带来负面影响。

affection.en: Their affection for her soon increased almost to idolatry.
affection.cn: 他们对她的喜爱不久就发展到了盲目崇拜的地步。

affection.en: Normally, such an outward display of affection is reserved for his mother.
affection.cn: 通常，只有在母亲面前他的情感才会如此外露。

affection.en: Right now I'm in need of a little filial affection.
affection.cn: 此刻我需要的是一份孝心。

affectional.en: The bonds of marriage and family life are no longer functional, but affectional.
affectional.cn: 这时,婚姻及家庭生活的纽带不再具有实用功能, 而具有了沟通情感的作用.

affectional.en: In the end, sexuality includes physical intimacy and affectional intimacy.
affectional.cn: 最后, 性既包括肉体上的亲密,也包含着情感上的亲密.

affectional.en: Carrie realised the change of affectional atmosphere at once.
affectional.cn: 嘉莉立刻感觉到气氛的变化.

affectionate.en: This collection of letters is affectionate, candid and wickedly funny.
affectionate.cn: 这本书信集感情真挚，语言坦率，还透着一种顽皮的滑稽。

affectionate.en: They seemed devoted to each other and were openly affectionate.
affectionate.cn: 他们看起来非常恩爱，柔情蜜意溢于言表。

affiliate.en: He said he wanted to affiliate with a U.S. firm because he needed "expert advice and counsel in legal affairs".
affiliate.cn: 他说他因为需要“在法律事务上得到专家的意见和建议”，所以想与一家美国律师事务所建立合作关系。

affiliate.en: The Government will not allow the staff association to affiliate with outside unions.
affiliate.cn: 政府不会允许其公务员协会与外部工会有紧密联系。

affiliate.en: Our New York company has an affiliate in Los Angeles.
affiliate.cn: 我们的纽约公司在洛杉矶有一个下属企业.

affiliation.en: The officer cited the federation's rule on affiliation.
affiliation.cn: 该官员引用了联邦政府对于隶属关系的规定。

affiliation.en: He was arrested because of his political affiliation.
affiliation.cn: 他因所属政党的关系而被捕。

affiliation.en: The group has no affiliation to any political party.
affiliation.cn: 该团体不隶属于任何政党。

affinity.en: Sam was born in the country and had a deep affinity with nature.
affinity.cn: 萨姆在乡下出生，特别喜爱大自然。

affinity.en: Many girls do show an affinity for craft skills.
affinity.cn: 确实有许多女孩子喜爱手工.

affinity.en: There is a natural affinity between British and Asian women.
affinity.cn: 英国女性和亚洲女性之间有一种自然的亲近感。

affirm.en: We gave them the opportunity to express their feelings, to affirm themselves.
affirm.cn: 我们给了他们一个机会表达自己的感情, 他们可以借此挺一挺腰杆.

affirm.en: This report is positively denied in official circles, who affirm that nothing of the kind occurred , but that the story is made out of whole cloth.
affirm.cn: 这篇报导为官方人士所断然否认, 他们断言根本没有这回事, 其内容纯属捏造.

affirm.en: Everything I had accomplished seemed to affirm that opinion.
affirm.cn: 我所取得的一切似乎都证明那个观点是对的。

affirmation.en: The ministers issued an affirmation of their faith in the system.
affirmation.cn: 部长们表示了对该体制坚定的信心。

affirmation.en: A single nod implies an affirmation.
The Director is awaiting the Board's affirmation of his nominee.
affirmation.cn: 董事长在等待董事会批准他提名的候选人.

affix.en: Complete the form and affix four tokens to its back.
affix.cn: 填完该表，在背面贴上4张凭券。

affix.en: Affix the blue airmail label and leave the rest to us.
affix.cn: 贴上蓝色的空邮标签，其余的事情交给我们。

affix.en: Affix the stamp to the upper right corner of the envelope.
affix.cn: 把邮票贴在信封上的右上角.

afflict.en: They may grant you power, honour, and riches but afflict you with servitude, infamy, and poverty.
afflict.cn: 他们可以给你权力 、 荣誉和财富,但却用奴役 、 耻辱和贫穷来折磨你.

afflict.en: Famine and war still afflict mankind.
afflict.cn: 饥饿和战争仍使人类遭受痛苦.

afflict.en: There are two main problems which afflict people with hearing impairments.
afflict.cn: 听力有障碍的人们主要受到两大问题的困扰。

affluent.en: The Strand is one of London's busiest and most affluent streets.
affluent.cn: 斯特兰德街是伦敦最繁华、最富足的街道之一。

affluent.en: The diet of the affluent has not changed much over the decades.
affluent.cn: 几十年来富人们的饮食习惯并未发生太大的变化。

afford.en: They pay full rates. Mind you, they can afford it.
afford.cn: 他们付全价，请注意，他们是付得起的。

afford.en: They could not afford to spoil those maps by careless colouring.
afford.cn: 若是上色的时候不小心弄坏了那些地图，他们可承担不起。

afford.en: It would be nice to be able to afford to retire earlier.
afford.cn: 无后顾之忧而能提早退休当是件幸事。

affront.en: He took his son's desertion as a personal affront.
affront.cn: 他把儿子的离开看作是对他个人的侮辱.

affront.en: She has taken my enquiry as a personal affront.
affront.cn: 她将我的询问当成了人身侮辱。

affront.en: It's an affront to human dignity to keep someone alive like this.
affront.cn: 如此维持一个人的生命是对人类尊严的冒犯。

afghanistan.en: The trip to Afghanistan was an adventure for Helen.
afghanistan.cn: 到阿富汗旅行对海伦来说是一次冒险的经历.

afghanistan.en: His book about Afghanistan is reviewed here by Anthony Hyman.
afghanistan.cn: 安东尼·海曼在此就他那本关于阿富汗的书写了书评。

afghanistan.en: He pulled back forces from Mongolia, and he withdrew from Afghanistan.
afghanistan.cn: 他从蒙古撤军，并且撤离阿富汗。

afield.en: During their summer holidays they cruised further afield to Normandy and Brittany.
afield.cn: 暑期他们乘船到更远的诺曼底和布列塔尼游览。

afield.en: Many of those arrested came from far afield.
afield.cn: 那些被捕者有许多来自很远的地方。

afield.en: British tour companies are nudging clients to travel further afield.
afield.cn: 英国旅游公司正鼓动客户到更远的地方去旅游。

afloat.en: They talked modestly of their valiant efforts to keep the tanker afloat.
afloat.cn: 他们说起自己设法使油轮漂浮的英勇之举时非常谦虚。

afloat.en: We kept her afloat for a couple of hours by bailing frantically.
afloat.cn: 我们拼命往外舀水，使它继续漂浮了几个小时。

afloat.en: A number of efforts were being made to keep the company afloat.
afloat.cn: 正采取各种措施来维持公司的正常资金周转。

afoul.en: All of them had run afoul of the law at some time or other.
afoul.cn: 他们所有人都曾触犯过法律。

afoul.en: The kites were afoul in the wind.
The paternal longing ran afoul of her own desire.
afoul.cn: 父亲的愿望和她的心愿相冲突.

afraid.en: Why should a great community like a university be afraid of nihilism?
afraid.cn: 为什么像大学这样人才济济的社区要害怕虚无主义呢？

afraid.en: "I'm afraid he's ill." — "I'm sorry to hear that."
She was afraid in a way that was quite new to her.
afraid.cn: 她感到从未有过的害怕。

africa.en: Mandela said, "We want a united, undivided South Africa".
africa.cn: 曼德拉说道：“我们想要一个团结统一的南非。”

africa.en: South Africa was going through a period of irreversible change.
africa.cn: 南非正在经历一场不可逆转的变革。

africa.en: The whole of Africa had been buffeted by social and political upheavals.
africa.cn: 整个非洲都经受了社会和政治动荡之苦。

african.en: Contemporary African cinema has much to offer in its vitality and freshness.
african.cn: 当代非洲电影在活力和新颖性上颇足称道。

african.en: And a number of African countries, too, are slipping through the net.
african.cn: 并且一些非洲国家也被漏掉了。

african.en: The African National Congress threatened to withdraw from the talks.
african.cn: 非洲国民大会威胁要退出会谈。

after.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
after.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

after.en: The mystery hero imme-diately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
after.cn: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

after.en: He was fired from his job after roughing up a colleague.
after.cn: 他因为对一位同事动粗而被开除了。

afterlife.en: How are God and the afterlife different?
afterlife.cn: 上帝和来世的生活有什麽不同的?

afterlife.en: People of many religions believe in an afterlife.
afterlife.cn: 很多宗教的信徒都相信来生.

afterlife.en: Why should the afterlife be any different?
afterlife.cn: 死亡的世界为什么不能有所改变?

aftermath.en: In the aftermath of the hurricane, many people's homes were destroyed.
aftermath.cn: 飓风的后果是许多人的房屋被毁.

aftermath.en: A lot of rebuilding took place in the aftermath of the war.
aftermath.cn: 战后进行了大量的重建工作。

aftermath.en: In the immediate aftermath of the riots, a mood of hope and reconciliation sprang up.
aftermath.cn: 暴乱过后紧接着出现了期待未来与盼望和解的气氛。

afternoon.en: The President met this afternoon with his top military advisers.
afternoon.cn: 总统今天下午会见了他最得力的军事顾问。

afternoon.en: It was a marvellous afternoon with a huge turnout of people.
afternoon.cn: 那是个美妙的下午，出席人数众多。

afternoon.en: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 school-children for an afternoon.
afternoon.cn: 他们一个下午成功接待了80名学童。

afterward.en: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
afterward.cn: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

afterward.en: Not long afterward she received five calls in one day.
afterward.cn: 不久之后，她一天内就接到了5个电话。

afterward.en: They came backstage afterward, cooing and toadying to him.
afterward.cn: 她们随后来到后台，对他娇语谄媚。

afterwards.en: Before the race, he is fine. But afterwards he is worn out.
afterwards.cn: 赛前他状态很好，赛后就筋疲力尽了。

afterwards.en: She wondered where they were going to rendezvous afterwards.
afterwards.cn: 她想知道之后他们要去哪里约会。

afterwards.en: Shortly afterwards, cuts in defence spending forced the aerospace industry to retrench.
afterwards.cn: 不久之后，国防开支的削减迫使航空航天业紧缩开支。

again.en: The central heating's been turned off. I've turned it on again.
again.cn: 中央供暖系统已经关上。我又将它打开了。

again.en: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try Again. Fail again. Fail better.
again.cn: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，每一次失败都比上一次更好。

again.en: "Ah, Captain Fox," Martin McGuinness said affably. "Nice to see you again."
again.cn: “啊，福克斯上尉，”马丁·麦吉尼斯亲切地说，“很高兴再次见到您。”

against.en: He spent 25 years campaigning against racist and unjust immigration laws.
against.cn: 他用了25年的时间与带有种族歧视色彩和没有公正可言的移民法作斗争。

against.en: "One thing you can never insure against is corruption among your staff."—"Agreed."
against.cn: “永远也防不胜防的就是员工内部的贪污腐败。”——“同意。”

against.en: He slewed the car against the side of the building.
against.cn: 他的车滑到了大楼的一侧，抵住了。

age.en: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
age.cn: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

age.en: In some cases there is a mini-mum age limit.
age.cn: 有些情况下有最低年龄限制。

age.en: He knew what he wanted to do from the age of 14.
age.cn: 他14岁起就知道自己日后干什么了。

agency.en: The agency should reduce turnaround time by 11 per cent.
agency.cn: 该代理机构应削减11%的周转时间。

agency.en: The advertising agency rang up 1.4 billion dollars in yearly sales.
agency.cn: 这家广告代理商每年销售额达14亿美元。

agency.en: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
agency.cn: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

agenda.en: Never before has a summit had such a crowded agenda.
agenda.cn: 以前从来没有一次峰会的日程排得这么满。

agenda.en: On arrival, a six-course meal was top of the agenda.
agenda.cn: 他们到达之后要做的第一件事是吃一顿六道菜的大餐。

agenda.en: Officials tussled over who had responsibility for the newly fashionable unemployment agenda.
agenda.cn: 众官员为谁负责最近备受关注的失业议题一事争得不可开交。

agent.en: We went straight to the estate agent and wrote out a cheque.
agent.cn: 我们径直到房地产经纪人那里开了一张支票。

agent.en: Cheap flights are available from budget travel agent from £240.
agent.cn: 收费低廉的旅行社可以提供240英镑起的低价机票。

agent.en: The agent spied for East Germany for more than twenty years.
agent.cn: 该特工人员为东德做了20多年的间谍。

aggravate.en: Men aggravate me when they go on about how impractical women are.
aggravate.cn: 男人们不断地谈论女人是如何不切实际的时候使我恼火.

aggregate.en: Newcastle went out of the competition, losing 2-1 on aggregate.
aggregate.cn: 纽卡斯尔队以1比2的总比分被淘汰出局。

aggregate.en: The football team had a low goal aggregate last season.
aggregate.cn: 这支足球队上个赛季的进球总数很少.

aggregation.en: Aggregation theory is concerned with the transition from micro - to macro - models.
aggregation.cn: 总量理论是研究从微观模型到 宏观 模型过渡的理论.

aggregation.en: A bigger objection is that aggregation of the results invites distortion.
aggregation.cn: 一种更大的异议是把各种结果集中考虑容易导致曲解。

aggregation.en: Moreover, aggregation influences the outcome of chemical disinfection of viruses.
aggregation.cn: 此外, 聚集作用还会影响化学消毒的效果.

aggression.en: His new relationship with Germany is enshrined in a new non-aggression treaty.
aggression.cn: 他与德国的新关系受新的互不侵犯条约的保护。

aggression.en: A non-aggression pact will be signed between the two countries.
aggression.cn: 两国将签署互不侵犯条约。

aggression.en: His relentless aggression bludgeons you into seeing his point.
aggression.cn: 他咄咄逼人地强迫你了解他的看法。

aggressive.en: Her aggressive moods alternated with gentle or more co-operative states.
aggressive.cn: 她情绪多变，时而咄咄逼人，时而又显得温柔平和或乐于合作。

aggressive.en: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive.
aggressive.cn: 他是一位锐意进取、竞争意识很强的主管，颇受尊敬。

aggressive.en: It could be argued that the British are not aggressive enough.
aggressive.cn: 可以说英国人不够强势。

agile.en: She is such an agile dancer!
agile.cn: 她跳起舞来是那么灵巧!

agile.en: An acrobat has to be agile.
agile.cn: 杂技演员必须身手敏捷.

agile.en: At 20 years old he was not as agile as he is now.
agile.cn: 20岁时他并不如现在这般矫健。

agility.en: With her speed and agility, Cage cut out all her competitors in the hurdle race.
agility.cn: 凯奇在跨栏赛跑中速度快、动作敏捷, 击败了所有其他选手.

agility.en: His intellect and mental agility have never been in doubt.
agility.cn: 他的才智和机敏从未受到怀疑。

agility.en: She blinked in surprise at his agility.
agility.cn: 他敏捷的身手让她惊奇地直眨眼睛。

agitate.en: All you need to do is gently agitate the water with a finger or paintbrush.
agitate.cn: 你只需要用手指或刷子轻轻地搅动水。

agitate.en: The women who worked in these mills had begun to agitate for better conditions.
agitate.cn: 在这些工厂里做工的妇女们开始抗议要求改善工作条件。

agitation.en: Danny returned to Father's house in a state of intense agitation.
agitation.cn: 丹尼回到神父的房子时显得极为焦虑不安。

agitation.en: Temperature is a measure of the agitation of the molecules of matter.
agitation.cn: 温度是物质分子运动的一个计量单位。

agitation.en: Diane lit a cigarette, trying to mask her agitation.
agitation.cn: 黛安娜点燃一根香烟，试图掩饰她的焦躁不安。

ago.en: Just a few days ago, I finished a commission.

desegregate.en: We have succeeded in persuading many districts to desegregate voluntarily.
desegregate.cn: 我们已圆满地劝服了许多地方自愿取消种族隔离.

desert.en: The vehicles have been modified to suit conditions in the desert.
desert.cn: 车辆已改装过以适应沙漠的环境。

desert.en: The paper'sprice rise will encourage readers to desert in even greater numbers.
desert.cn: 报纸价格的上涨将导致更多的读者不再订阅。

desert.en: Young workers are more willing to desert jobs they don't like.
desert.cn: 年轻职工对不喜欢的工作更易擅自离职。

deserted.en: She had the look of someone deserted and betrayed.
deserted.cn: 她一副遭人遗弃和背叛的样子。

deserted.en: The house seemed muted, hushed as if it had been deserted.
deserted.cn: 房子里似乎悄然无声，安静得好像已经没人在住一样。

deserted.en: Courage seems now to have deserted him. May it quickly reappear.
deserted.cn: 他现在似乎失去了勇气，但愿他能很快重新振作起来。

deserve.en: He does deserve some good luck after so much wretchedness.
deserve.cn: 经过这么多苦难之后，他应该行点好运了。

deserve.en: Clare did not deserve the vilification she had been subjected to.
deserve.cn: 克莱尔不该受到这样的诽谤。

deserve.en: His children's books are classics that deserve to be much better known.
deserve.cn: 他的儿童书非常经典，应该为更多人所知晓。

desiccation.en: Application: Suitable for desiccation, medical treatment and poultry artificial incubation.
desiccation.cn: 用途: 干燥 、 医疗和家禽人工孵化.

desiccation.en: Desiccation The drying out of an organism due to evaporation.
desiccation.cn: 干燥(脱水):由于蒸发而干燥的生物体.

desiccation.en: Spores normally resist desiccation and have many ordinary procedures of disinfection.
desiccation.cn: 芽孢能抗干燥并且有很多普通的消毒方法.

design.en: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.
design.cn: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。

design.en: They drew up the design for the house in a week.
design.cn: 他们在一周内就画出了房子的图样。

design.en: The grand design of Europe's monetary union is already agreed.
design.cn: 欧洲统一货币的宏伟构想已经获得认同。

designate.en: Will you designate the flowers you wish?
designate.cn: 你能说出你想要的花 吗 ?

designate.en: Japan'sPrime Minister-designate is completing his Cabinet today.
designate.cn: 日本的当选首相今日将完成组阁。

designate.en: There are efforts under way to designate the bridge a historic landmark.
designate.cn: 人们正在努力将这座桥定为历史遗迹。

designation.en: The women's liberation movement adopted the designation as its own.
designation.cn: 妇女解放运动采用了这个称呼.

designation.en: The district is under consideration for designation as a conservation area.
designation.cn: 正在考虑将这个地区指定为保护区。

designation.en: The designation of special marine reserves and marine sanctuaries shall be subject to the State Council for approval.
designation.cn: 海洋特别保护区、海上自然保护区的确定,须经国务院批准.

designer.en: She asked her son, a graphic designer, to create letterheads and stationery.
designer.cn: 她请做平面设计师的儿子设计了信头和信笺。

designer.en: People want to buy designer labels for snob value.
designer.cn: 人们想买名牌是为了满足虚荣心。

designer.en: She began a torrid love affair with a theatrical designer.
designer.cn: 她和一位舞台设计师开始了一场狂热的恋情。

desirability.en: Mel was conscious, as at other times, of her desirability and warmth.
desirability.cn: 梅尔像往常一样, 感到她的希求和温情.

desirability.en: The conversation ranged over the desirability of such restaurants, the shortcomings of men, and why it had only taken 15 minutes to cross a continent.
desirability.cn: 谈话涉及了这类餐馆的吸引人之处、男人的弱点，还有为什么只用15分钟就跨越了一个大洲。

desirability.en: They clearly thought he needed prodding on the desirability of relaxing tensions.
desirability.cn: 他们显然认为,他需要力陈一下缓和紧张局势的好处.

desirable.en: The most desirable properties necessarily command astonishingly high prices.
desirable.cn: 最值得拥有的财产必然要价不菲。

desirable.en: Rolls Royce produces around 1,000 extremely desirable cars a year.
desirable.cn: 劳斯莱斯公司每年生产约1,000辆非常吸引人的汽车。

desirable.en: The crowd moved indoors for what were deemed the most desirable items.
desirable.cn: 人群为了被视为最值得拥有的物品涌入屋里。

desire.en: The desire to be a mother may creep up on you unexpectedly.
desire.cn: 你会不知不觉地产生想当母亲的渴望。

desire.en: She confessed to her parents her desire to act.
desire.cn: 她向父母坦言了自己想演戏的愿望。

desire.en: I had a strong desire to help and care for people.
desire.cn: 我非常渴望能够帮助和照顾他人。

desk.en: They will need a reasonable amount of desk area and good light.
desk.cn: 他们将需要一个面积较大的摆放办公桌的地方和充足的照明。

desk.en: He gave the girl at the desk the message.
desk.cn: 他把便条递给了桌旁的女孩。

desk.en: He folded the papers and stuck them in his desk drawer.
desk.cn: 他将文件叠起来，塞进自己的书桌抽屉里。

desolate.en: The house was desolate, ready to be torn down.
desolate.cn: 这房子没人居住, 等着拆除.

desolate.en: Half-ruined, hardly a building untouched, it's a desolate place.
desolate.cn: 这里大半遭毁，几乎没有一栋建筑完好无损，变成了一块荒废之地。

despair.en: As his energy drained away, his despair and worry grew.
despair.cn: 当他的精力耗尽时，他的绝望和担心也增加了。

despair.en: Don't let yourself despair; this will only make matters worse.
despair.cn: 不要想不开，这样只能使情况变得更糟。

despair.en: I would overcome any weakness, any despair, any fear.
despair.cn: 我要克服所有的软弱、绝望和恐惧。

despatch.en: The despatch of the task force is purely a contingency measure.
despatch.cn: 派出特遣部队纯粹是应急之举。

despatch.en: The fox takes his chance with a pack of hounds which may catch him and despatch him immediately.
despatch.cn: 那只狐狸和一群随时可能置其于死地的猎狗冒险周旋。

despatch.en: He feels we should act with despatch.
despatch.cn: 他觉得我们应该迅速行动。

desperate.en: Car firms are desperate to achieve economies of scale.
desperate.cn: 汽车厂商拼命想要实现规模经济。

desperate.en: The company'sclosure has left many small businessmen in desperate financial straits.
desperate.cn: 该公司的倒闭让很多小商人陷入了经济困境。

desperate.en: They admit they are now desperate for a lucky break.
desperate.cn: 他们承认现在急盼幸运之神的降临。

despoil.en: The city of greece and asia is despoil of their most valuable ornament.
despoil.cn: 希腊与亚洲城市中最宝贵的装饰品被劫掠一空.

despoil.en: " Thy voice, and suddenly grow grey with fear, And tremble and despoil themselves: 0 hear! "
despoil.cn: 听到你的声音, 它们已吓得发青: 一边颤栗,一边自动萎缩: 哦,你听!

despoil.en: The victorious army despoil the city of all its treasure.
despoil.cn: 得胜的军队把城里的财宝劫掠一空。

despondent.en: She was becoming increasingly despondent about the way things were going.
despondent.cn: 她对情况的发展越来越失望。

despondent.en: He was up for a time and then, without warning, despondent again.
despondent.cn: 他一度兴高采烈, 但忽然又情绪低落下来.

dessert.en: "I really want some dessert," Keaton says, smacking his lips.
dessert.cn: “我真的很想吃点儿点心，”基顿咂着嘴说。

dessert.en: He finished his dessert and patted his paunch.
dessert.cn: 他吃完甜点，拍了拍他的大肚子。

dessert.en: Scott was obviously inebriated by the time the dessert was served.
dessert.cn: 到了上甜点的时候，斯科特显然已经喝醉了。

destination.en: His destination was Chobham Common, a long way from his Cotswold home.
destination.cn: 他的目的地是乔伯姆公地，那里和他在科茨沃尔德的家离得很远。

destination.en: You can check your baggage right through to its final destination.
destination.cn: 你可以把行李直接托运到终点。

destination.en: St Lucia is still mercifully undeveloped as a tourist destination.
destination.cn: 作为一个旅游目的地，圣卢西亚所幸还未被开发。

destine.en: Induct electric power cable , shell up the destine length.
destine.cn: 引入电力电缆, 在预定长度剥开.

destine.en: The cigarette love with match, destine to be hurt.
destine.cn: 香烟爱上火柴, 就注定被伤害.

destine.en: She feel she be destine to be unhappy for the rest of her life.
destine.cn: 她认为她命中注定余生不会再有快乐.

destiny.en: It is my destiny one day to be king.
destiny.cn: 我命中注定有一天要成为国王。

destiny.en: Destiny has ordained that they are who they are.
destiny.cn: 命运已经决定了他们的性格为人。

destiny.en: He departed this world with a sense of having fulfilled his destiny.
destiny.cn: 他带着一种已完成使命的满足感离开了这个世界。

destroy.en: Frogs eat pests which destroy crops and carry diseases.
destroy.cn: 青蛙吃破坏庄稼、传播疾病的害虫。

destroy.en: They can't destroy truth without destroying each and every one of us.
destroy.cn: 除非他们将我们赶尽杀绝，否则真理不灭。

destroy.en: After the killing, he calmly lit a fire to destroy evidence.
destroy.cn: 杀人后，他镇定地点起火销毁罪证。

destruction.en: To that extent they helped bring about their own destruction.
destruction.cn: 他们正是如此推波助澜，导致了自己的毁灭。

destruction.en: There is worldwide concern about the destruction of the rainforests.
destruction.cn: 全世界都在关注热带雨林遭到破坏的问题。

destruction.en: One eye-witness said the rioters were engaged in an orgy of destruction.
destruction.cn: 一位目击者称暴徒肆无忌惮地到处进行破坏。

destructive.en: Although not ideal, this attitude is not entirely destructive.
destructive.cn: 这种态度虽然不够理想，但还不至于消极透顶。

destructive.en: He was unable to contain his own destructive feelings.
destructive.cn: 他无法抑制自己消极的情绪。

destructive.en: Tanks are heavy on fuel and destructive to roads.
destructive.cn: 坦克要耗费大量的燃料，而且会破坏道路。

detach.en: It helps them detach themselves from their problems and become more objective.
detach.cn: 这有助于他们从所面临的问题中跳出来，变得更客观一些。

detach.en: Detach the coupon and return it as soon as possible.
detach.cn: 将赠券撕下后尽快寄回。

detach.en: It is easy to detach the currants from the stems.
detach.cn: 很容易就能把醋栗从梗上摘下来。

detached.en: It is written in a detached, precise style.
detached.cn: 行文冷静客观，一针见血。

detachment.en: He answered with an air of detachment.
detachment.cn: 他回答时带着冷漠的神态。

detachment.en: Ridley viewed his work with a cynical detachment.
detachment.cn: 里德利以一种吹毛求疵的超然态度看待他的作品。

detachment.en: One detachment pushed into the eastern suburbs towards the airfield.
detachment.cn: 一支小分队开进了东部郊区向飞机场挺进。

detail.en: No detail was too small to escape her attention.
detail.cn: 再小的细节都逃不过她的眼睛。

detail.en: Though off-puttingly complicated in detail, local taxes are in essence simple.
detail.cn: 虽然地税在细节上复杂得要命，但在本质上却很简单。

detail.en: The painting had been executed with meticulous attention to detail.
detail.cn: 画这幅画的时候，画家非常注意细节。

detailed.en: We'll put together a proposal, including detailed costings, free of charge.
detailed.cn: 我们将免费拟一份提案，其中包括详细的成本估算。

detailed.en: Yesterday's letter contains a detailed account of the decisions.
detailed.cn: 昨天的那封信里有对这些决议的详细说明。

detailed.en: He gave a detailed account of what happened on the fateful night.
detailed.cn: 他详细描述了那个灾难性夜晚所发生的事。

detain.en: Thank you. We won't detain you any further.
detain.cn: 非常感谢。我们就不再耽搁您的时间了。

detain.en: It is against the law to detain you against your will for any length of time.
detain.cn: 无论强制扣押多长时间都属违法。

detain.en: He caught her arm in a subconscious attempt to detain her.
detain.cn: 他下意识地抓住她的胳膊想挽留她。

detect.en: He conjectured that some individuals may be able to detect major calamities.
detect.cn: 他猜测说有些人也许能够察觉重大灾难。

detect.en: We are trying to detect and understand how the climates change.
detect.cn: 我们正努力探寻并理解气候是如何变化的。

detect.en: An observant doctor can often detect depression from expression, posture, and movement.
detect.cn: 善于观察的医生常常能从人的表情、姿势以及动作诊察出抑郁症。

detectable.en: The noise is barely detectable by the human ear.
detectable.cn: 人的耳朵几乎是察觉不到这种噪音的。

detectable.en: Dark matter gives out no light and is detectable only because of its gravitational effect on visible matter.
detectable.cn: 暗物质不发光，它之所以能被发现，只是因为它对可见物质产生引力作用。

detectable.en: Doctors say the disease is probably inherited but not detectable at birth.
detectable.cn: 医生说该疾病可能是遗传而来，但在出生时无法查出。

detection.en: The detection rate for racial crimes is appallingly low.
detection.cn: 种族罪案的侦破率之低让人震惊。

detection.en: The plane is used for electronic jamming and radar detection.
detection.cn: 这架飞机用于进行电子干扰和雷达探测。

detective.en: Joan Smith's detective stories are a cut above the rest.
detective.cn: 琼·史密斯的侦探小说比其他侦探小说都要出色。

detective.en: "Once a detective, always a detective," he said lightly.
detective.cn: “一日为侦探，终生为侦探，”他满不在意地说。

detective.en: I don't have to be a detective to figure that out.

detector.en: We are forced to use a multiplicity of separate detector arrays.
detector.cn: 我们要尽力用多个分离的检测器组成.

detector.en: Their approach is to scan every checked-in bag with a bomb detector.
detector.cn: 他们的方法是用炸弹探测器对每一个办理了登机手续的箱包进行扫描。

detector.en: "Do you have a metal detector?" — "No, I don't."
detector.cn: “你有金属探测仪吗？”——“不，我没有。”

deter.en: All the doors have been bricked up to deter vandals.
deter.cn: 所有的门都用砖堵了起来，防止破坏分子闯入。

deter.en: Such a statement was hardly calculated to deter future immigrants.
deter.cn: 这样的声明不太可能吓住将来的移民。

deter.en: Arming the police doesn't deter crime.
deter.cn: 仅仅靠给警察配备武器是无法制止犯罪的。

detergent.en: The active ingredient in some of the mouthwashes was simply detergent.
detergent.cn: 某些漱口剂中的有效成分只不过是洗涤剂而已。

detergent.en: Grease marks can be removed with liquid detergent.
Wash in warm water with liquid detergent.

deteriorate.en: The position of the have-nots in our society could deteriorate even further.
deteriorate.cn: 穷人的社会地位可能会进一步恶化。

deteriorate.en: Police, weary and increasingly sour in mood, wonder aloud why the situation has been allowed to deteriorate.
deteriorate.cn: 警察们疲惫不堪，心情也越来越糟糕，他们不禁满腹狐疑地问：为什么听凭情况不断地恶化下去？

deteriorate.en: Food is apt to deteriorate in summer.

deterioration.en: The subhuman conditions of work soon caused physical deterioration.
deterioration.cn: 非人的工作环境不久就导致了身体状况的恶化。

deterioration.en: Mental and physical deterioration both occur naturally with age.
deterioration.cn: 随着年龄的增长,心智和体力自然衰退.

deterioration.en: The recent deterioration has been caused by an apparently endless recession.
deterioration.cn: 看似永无止境的经济衰退导致了最近的恶化。

determinant.en: The determinant can be evaluated from the cofactors of any column.
determinant.cn: 行列式可根据任何一列余因子来求算.

determinant.en: This determinant is a special case of the resultant of two polynomials.
determinant.cn: 这个行列式是两个行列式的结式的特殊情形.

determinant.en: The main stem and fruiting branches of determinant types remain relatively short.
determinant.cn: 有限生长类型的主茎和果枝仍然较短.

determination.en: Their indecision has been replaced by confidence and steely determination.
determination.cn: 他们的优柔寡断已经被自信和钢铁般的决心所取代。

determination.en: It must have reinforced my determination to blend into my surroundings.
determination.cn: 这势必让我更加下定决心融入周围环境。

determination.en: Kauffman was a woman of unique talent and determination.
determination.cn: 考夫曼是一个有着超群才智和决断力的女子。

determine.en: An astronomer can determine the brightness of each star.
determine.cn: 天文学家能够测定每颗恒星的亮度。

determine.en: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.--Zig Ziglar
determine.cn: 决定你人生高度的，不是你的才能，而是你的态度。

determine.en: A debriefing would follow this operation, to determine where it went wrong.
determine.cn: 这次行动之后将会有一个任务执行情况报告会，以便确定是哪里出了问题。

determinedly.en: " Don't shove me,'said one of the strikers, determinedly. " I'm not doing anything. "
determinedly.cn: “ 别推我, "其中的一个罢工工人坚决地说, " 我可没干什么. ”

determinedly.en: Dorothy's chin set determinedly as she looked calmly at him.
determinedly.cn: 多萝西平静地看着他,下巴绷得紧紧的,看来是打定主意了.

deterrent.en: Hopefully his punishment will act as a deterrent to others.
deterrent.cn: 对他的惩罚但愿能起到杀一儆百的作用。

deterrent.en: They seriously believe that capital punishment is a deterrent.
deterrent.cn: 他们真的相信死刑具有威慑作用。

deterrent.en: Long prison sentences can be a very effective deterrent for offenders.
deterrent.cn: 判处长期徒刑可对违法者起到强有力的威慑作用。

detract.en: These revelations should not detract from his achievements.
detract.cn: 不应该因暴露出来的这些事而贬低他的成就.

detract.en: That does not detract from his merit.
A cur barking at the sun cannot detract from its glory.
detract.cn: 狂犬吠日,无损于太阳的光辉.

detractor.en: A certain partner, competitor, or detractor is due to be unpredictable and challenging.
detractor.cn: 一个合作伙伴 、 竞争对手或者小人会在当天不可预料地给你带来麻烦.

detritus.en: Detritus usually consists of gravel, sand and clay.
detritus.cn: 岩屑通常是由砂砾, 沙和粘土组成的.

detritus.en: organic detritus from fish and plants
A channel is no sooner cut than it chokes in its own detritus.
detritus.cn: 一个河道刚被切割了不久,很快又被它自己的碎屑物质所充塞.

devastate.en: The Lurker focuses on spies, cloaks and subterfuge to devastate opponents.
devastate.cn: 潜行者专注于使用间谍, 掩饰,和诡计去摧毁敌人.

devastate.en: This September I was invited to devastate the moors of a friend in the north.
devastate.cn: 这年九月我被北方一个朋友邀请去遨游他的原野.

devastate.en: They intended to devastate the town at one stroke.
devastate.cn: 他们企图一举摧毁全城.

devastation.en: It's a scene of complete devastation.
devastation.cn: 那是一副满目疮痍的景象。

devastation.en: Adam stumbles on, leaving a trail of devastation in his wake.
devastation.cn: 亚当蹒跚而行，沿路留下毁坏的痕迹。

develop.en: You have to develop your capabilities to the maximum.
We have to develop a less amateurish approach to our organisa-tions.
develop.cn: 我们必须使我们对待自己组织的态度变得较为专业。

develop.en: She won a grant to develop her own business.
develop.cn: 她赢得了一笔拨款，用以扩展自己的企业。

developer.en: Tom is a real estate developer.
developer.cn: 汤姆是位房地产开发商.

developer.en: John Bardeen was also co-developer of the theory of superconductivity.
developer.cn: 约翰·巴丁也是超导电性理论的创立者之一。

developer.en: He was a very late developer.

development.en: They identified six plants as having potential for development into pharmaceutical drugs.
development.cn: 他们验明6种植物有可能提炼出药物麻醉剂。

development.en: What are your plans for the development of your company?
development.cn: 你打算怎样来发展壮大自己的公司？

dorsal.cn: 它的脊鳍朝下耷拉着,巨大的胸鳍大张着.

dosage.cn: 给他服了大剂量的维生素C。

double.cn: 两家的双人客房都报出了大约90英镑的超值价格。

double.cn: 别担心，我们会很快把你从这儿弄出去的。

doubtful.cn: 有一段时间他似乎根本不会搬家。

doubtful.cn: 当局是否允许检查还是个大问号。

doubtless.cn: 他那直截了当、往往还粗鲁生硬的办事方式无疑会激怒一些人。

doubtless.cn: 病毒和逻辑炸弹在某些情况下无疑会造成巨大危害。

downstairs.cn: 两栋小楼的底层已经彻底翻修过。

downtown.cn: 本市现在提供从市中心到体育场的免费交通。

downward.en: His adult life mirrored the downward course of his father's life.

drab.en: Mary was wearing the same drab grey dress.
drab.cn: 玛丽穿着同一件毫无朝气的灰色裙子。

drab.cn: 这座城市白天死气沉沉、单调乏味，晚上就完全变了样。

dram.en: Would you care for a dram?

lengthy.cn: 盖茨以一篇有关部署策略的鸿篇大论予以回应。

lens.en: Your camcorder should have these basic features: autofocus, playback facility, zoom lens.
lens.cn: 你的便携式摄像机应该具备以下基本功能：自动聚焦、回放功能、变焦镜头。

lens.en: Why aren't all lenses supplied with a lens hood?
lens.cn: 为什么不给所有的镜头都配上遮光罩呢？

lens.en: The autoexposure button is awkwardly placed under the lens release button.
lens.cn: 自动曝光按钮安装在镜头脱卸按钮下面，十分不便。

leo.en: Leo went on, his dark eyes wide with pity and concern.
leo.cn: 利奥接着说下去，他的黑眼睛瞪得大大的，充满怜悯和关切。

leo.en: The little boy stepped forward timidly and shook Leo's hand.
leo.cn: 小男孩羞怯地走上前去握了握利奥的手。

leo.en: I don't believe he would tell Leo such a thing.
leo.cn: 我不信他会告诉利奥这种事。

leopard.en: Among the carnivorous animals are the leopard, lion, and tiger.
leopard.cn: 食肉动物中有豹子 、 狮子和老虎.

leopard.en: Which has spots, the leopard or the tiger?
A leopard hunts alone, and an injured leopard cannot hunt.
leopard.cn: 豹向来单独猎食，所以如果受伤了就无法捕猎。

less.en: These files have been zipped up to take up less disk space.
less.cn: 这些文档已经进行了压缩，以节省磁盘空间。

less.en: He is lined up for no less than four US television interviews.
less.cn: 多达4家美国电视媒体排期邀请他上节目接受采访。

less.en: Other amenities, less commonly available, include a library and exercise room.
less.cn: 还有一些不太常有的设施，包括图书馆和健身房。

lessen.en: Toolbelts free both hands and lessen the risk of dropping hammers.
lessen.cn: 工具腰带解放了双手，还减少了锤子掉落的风险。

lessen.en: Several drugs are used to lessen the severity of the symptoms.
lessen.cn: 使用了几种药来减轻症状。

lesson.en: It was the quickest swimming lesson I'd ever witnessed.
lesson.cn: 这是我所见过的最速成的游泳课。

lesson.en: He learned this lesson the hard way from his own personal experience.
lesson.cn: 吃一堑长一智，他这个教训来之不易——是从他自己的亲身经历中得来的。

lesson.en: The lesson from all of this is perhaps a broader one.
lesson.cn: 从所有这一切中得出的教训可能具有更广泛的意义。

lest.en: Be careful lest you ( should ) fall from the tree.
lest.cn: 小心,不要从树上掉下来.

lest.en: He gripped his brother's arm lest he be trampled by the mob.
lest.cn: 他紧抓着他兄弟的胳膊，怕他让暴民踩着。

lest.en: They decided to retreat lest they would be between two fires.
lest.cn: 他们决定撤退,否则就要受两面夹击.

let.en: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
let.cn: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

let.en: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.
let.cn: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。

let.en: If they value these data, let them pay for them.
let.cn: 他们要是看重这些数据，就让他们出钱买。

lethal.en: Execution by lethal injection is scheduled for July 30th.
lethal.cn: 定于7月30日执行注射死刑。

lethal.en: The barriers are lethal to fish trying to swim upstream.
lethal.cn: 这些障碍物对于想要往上游游动的鱼儿来说是致命的。

lethal.en: High-powered cars are lethal weapons in the hands of inexperienced drivers.
lethal.cn: 马力大的汽车到了缺乏经验的司机手中便成了毁灭性的武器。

lethargic.en: It'served to make him rebellious and hence lethargic at times.
lethargic.cn: 这种情况引起他对现状的反抗心理,有时候便老是没精打采.

lethargic.en: It made us all lethargic before we had gone far.
lethargic.cn: 行不多远,大伙儿都意兴索然.

lethargic.en: He felt too miserable and lethargic to get dressed.
lethargic.cn: 他心情低落，无精打采，完全没有心思穿衣整装。

lethargy.en: Sleep deprivation can cause stress, loss of appetite and lethargy.
lethargy.cn: 睡眠不足会导致紧张 、 没有胃口和懒散.

lethargy.en: After the meal, I could feel lethargy overtaking me.
Symptoms include tiredness, paleness, and lethargy.
lethargy.cn: 症状包括疲倦、脸色苍白、没有精神。

letter.en: The letter merely restated the law of the land.
letter.cn: 这封信只不过重复了一下土地法。

letter.en: The things that stuck out were his cockiness and his four-letter words.
letter.cn: 与众不同之处在于他的骄傲自大和满嘴脏话。

letter.en: The letter was short — a simple recitation of their problem.
letter.cn: 信写得很短——只是简单地说了一下他们的问题。

lettuce.en: Wash the lettuce and pat it dry.
Lettuce was grown by the Ancient Romans.
lettuce.cn: 古罗马人最先种植莴苣。

level.en: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
level.cn: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

level.en: Faculty members complain that their students are unprepared to do college-level work.
level.cn: 学院的老师们抱怨说他们的学生还很不适应大学的课业。

level.en: The water level in Lake Taihu has reached record levels.
level.cn: 太湖水位达到了历史最高值。

lever.en: Press the lever until you hear the catch engage.
lever.cn: 压下挡杆，直到听到挡挂好。

lever.en: An elevator mechanic can work the machinery directly by turning this lever.
lever.cn: 电梯修理工可以转动这根杠杆直接操作机器。

lever.en: I put the coin in the machine and pulled the lever.
lever.cn: 我把硬币投入机器，拉动控制杆。

levy.en: They levy a tax on him.
A direct food levy was imposed by the local government.
levy.cn: 地方政府征收了食品税.

levy.en: It turns out Levy is talking in metaphorical terms.
levy.cn: 利维原来说的是一种比喻。

lewis.en: This morning, looking harassed and drawn, Lewis tendered his resignation.
lewis.cn: 今天早晨，刘易斯面色憔悴、疲惫不堪地递交了辞呈。

lewis.en: "What am I doing wrong, anyway?" — "Beats me, Lewis."
lewis.cn: “不管怎样，我到底做错了什么？”——“这我也不知道，刘易斯。”

lewis.en: Lewis is matched against the WBO's heavyweight champion, Tommy Morrison.
lewis.cn: 刘易斯对决世界拳击组织的重量级拳王汤米·莫里森。

liability.en: Bad pronunciation is a liability in being a narrator.
liability.cn: 不良的发音是做解说员的不利条件.

liability.en: Because of his injury Tom was just a liability to the team.
liability.cn: 汤姆的伤使他成为全队的累赘.

liability.en: The company cannot accept liability for any damage caused by natural disasters.
liability.cn: 该公司对自然灾害造成的任何损失概不承担责任。

liable.en: Offenders will be liable to a seven-year prison term.
Educational practice is liable to sudden swings and changes.
liable.cn: 教学实践中经常会出现突然的变化与改革。

liable.en: Such a figure is liable to be attacked as a blasphemer.
liable.cn: 这样的人很容易被人抨击为亵渎神明。

liar.en: "Liar!" Sarah screamed, as she thrashed the child. "You stole it."
liar.cn: “叫你撒谎！”萨拉一边揍着孩子，一边尖叫道，“就是你偷的。”

liar.en: "She seems at times an accomplished liar," he said.
He was a congenital liar and usually in debt.
liar.cn: 他生性爱说谎，而且通常债务缠身。

libel.en: Canadian libel law is based on English common law.
libel.cn: 加拿大的诽谤法是以英国的习惯法为基础的。

libel.en: Mr Warren sued him for libel over the remarks.
libel.cn: 沃伦先生控告他散布诽谤性言论。

libel.en: She had a libel action against the magazine pending.
libel.cn: 她对该杂志提起的诽谤诉讼尚未判决。

libelous.en: The book was libelous, so the publishers had to call in all copies of it from the bookshops.
libelous.cn: 这是一本诽谤性的书, 所以出版商必须把店里的书全收回去.

libelous.en: No evidence has been found in the case so far and therefore it is probably a libelous suit.
Here, the truer the scandal, the more libelous it is.
libelous.cn: 在这儿, 丑事愈真实,诽谤的罪就愈大.

liberal.en: The attitude of the medical profession is very much more liberal now.
liberal.cn: 现在，医务人员的态度开明多了。

liberal.en: The electoral fortunes of the Liberal Democratic party may decline.
liberal.cn: 自由民主党的选举运势可能会下降。

liberal.en: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
liberal.cn: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

liberate.en: You should liberate the mind from prejudice.
They did their best to liberate slaves.
liberate.cn: 他们尽最大能力去解放奴隶.

liberate.en: This will liberate him from economic worry.
liberate.cn: 这将消除他经济上的忧虑.

liberation.en: We should help those who are still struggling for liberation.
liberation.cn: 我们应当帮助那些仍在为独立而斗争的人们.

liberation.en: women's liberation from the bondage of domestic life
liberation.cn: 女性从家庭生活束缚中的解脱

liberation.en: Dawkins ends his discussion with a call for liberation.
liberation.cn: 道金斯以呼吁解放结束了他的论述。

liberty.en: The Puritans became fugitives in quest of liberty.
liberty.cn: 清教徒变成了追求自由的逃亡者。

liberty.en: He firmly believes liberty is inseparable from social justice.
liberty.cn: 他坚信自由与社会正义是不可分的。

liberty.en: I am afraid we are not at liberty to disclose that information.
liberty.cn: 恐怕我们无权透露这一信息。

librarian.en: The old librarian illuminated some old books and manuscripts.
librarian.cn: 这个老图书馆员把一些古书和旧抄稿加上各种装饰.

librarian.en: The librarian entered a new book in the catalogue.
librarian.cn: 图书管理员把一本新书编入目录.

librarian.en: His father is the librarian of our school library.
librarian.cn: 他父亲是我们学校的图书馆馆长.

library.en: Other amenities, less commonly available, include a library and exercise room.
library.cn: 还有一些不太常有的设施，包括图书馆和健身房。

library.en: I was going to pop up to the local library.
library.cn: 我正打算到邻近的图书馆跑一趟。

library.en: The British Library holds its collection in trust for the nation.
library.cn: 大不列颠图书馆为国家保存被托管藏书。

licence.en: The painting was returned to Spain on a temporary import licence.
licence.cn: 这幅画凭着临时进口许可证被送回了西班牙。

licence.en: This licence would not allow him to trade as a plc.
licence.cn: 这个许可证并不能让他以公开股份有限公司的名义从事贸易。

licence.en: It transpired that Paolo had left his driving licence at home.
licence.cn: 后来才知道保罗把驾照忘在家里了。

license.en: The driver was arrested for having false license plates on his car.
license.cn: 司机由于使用假车牌而被捕.

license.en: The government revoked her husband's license to operate migrant labor crews.
license.cn: 政府撤销了她丈夫管理外来打工人群的许可证。

license.en: The foreign guest has a license on the person.
license.cn: 这个外国客人随身携带执照.

lichen.en: The case was diagnosed as lichen sclerosus et atrophicus with localized scleroderma.
lichen.cn: 患者诊断为硬化萎缩性苔藓合并局限性硬皮病.

lichen.en: The stone stairway was covered with lichen.
Lichen is a form in which green or bluegreen algae and a fungus live together symbiotically.
lichen.cn: 地衣是一种绿藻或蓝藻与一种真菌共生的形式.

lick.en: He might be able to lick us all in a fair fight.
lick.cn: 如果公平较量，他也许能将我们所有人都轻易打败。

lick.en: You'll have four months in which to lick the recruits into shape.
lick.cn: 你将有4个月的时间把这些新兵训练出来。

lick.en: My room needed a lick of paint to freshen it up.
lick.cn: 我的房间只要刷一点油漆就能焕然一新。

lid.en: The lid, turned upside down, served as a coffee table.
lid.cn: 那个盖子被翻过来当作咖啡桌。

lid.en: As we drew near, I saw that the boot lid was up.
lid.cn: 我们靠近时,我看见汽车行李箱的盖子翘了起来.

lid.en: The soldiers' presence seemed to keep a lid on the violence.
lid.cn: 士兵的存在似乎抑制住了暴力活动。

lie.en: Lie face upwards with a cushion under your head.
The ship would lie there mirrored in a perfectly unmoving glossy sea.
lie.cn: 船会停靠在那里，映衬在一片波澜不兴的湛蓝海水之中。

lie.en: The blame for the Charleston fiasco did not lie with him.
lie.cn: 查尔斯顿惨败错不在他。

lien.en: A lien against the property is granted to secure an obligation.
lien.cn: 准予对财产拥有留置权以保证义务之履行.

lien.en: The court granted me a lien on my debtor's property.
lien.cn: 法庭授予我对我债务人财产的留置权.

lien.en: For the loan, he could have a lien placed on your home.
lien.cn: 因为此笔贷款, 他对你的住房享有留置权.

lieu.en: He left what little furniture he owned to his landlord in lieu of rent.
lieu.cn: 他把自己仅有的那点家具留给了房东抵房租。

lieu.en: A 10 percent service charge is added in lieu of tipping.
lieu.cn: 加收了10%的服务费以代替小费。

lieu.en: The company offered us time off in lieu.
lieu.cn: 公司叫我们用休假来代替.

lieutenant.en: Fusilier Jones ran towards the Ops Room to find his lieutenant.
lieutenant.cn: 燧发枪团士兵琼斯奔向作战指挥室寻找他的中尉长官。

lieutenant.en: I'm a novice at these things, Lieutenant. You're the professional.
lieutenant.cn: 中尉，做这些事情我是新手，你是行家。

lieutenant.en: As a second lieutenant, he had to salute damned near everybody.
lieutenant.cn: 身为少尉，他几乎是逢人便得敬礼。

life.en: The happiest are not those who own all the best things, but those who can appreciate the beauty of life.
life.cn: 最幸福的人们并不一定什么都是最好，只是他们懂得欣赏生活的美好。

life.en: No matter where you go in life or how old you get, there's always something new to learn about. After all, life is full of surprises.
life.cn: 不管你生活在哪里，你有多少岁，总有新东西要学习，毕竟，生活总是充满惊喜。

life.en: If you love life, life will love you back.
life.cn: 热爱生活，生活也会厚爱你。(Arthur Rubinstein)

lifeblood.en: Tourism is the lifeblood of the city.
lifeblood.cn: 旅游业是这座城市的命脉。

lifeblood.en: Small businesses are the lifeblood of the economy.
lifeblood.cn: 小型企业是经济的生命力所在。

lifeblood.en: Coal and steel were the region's lifeblood.
lifeblood.cn: 煤炭和钢铁曾是这个地区的生命线。

lifelike.en: The mask was so lifelike it was quite frightening.
lifelike.cn: 该面具非常逼真以至看起来有点恐怖.

lifelike.en: The portrayal of the characters in the novel is lifelike.
lifelike.cn: 该书中的人物写得有血有肉.

lifelike.en: The galloping horses he paints are extremely lifelike.
lifelike.cn: 他画的奔马,栩栩如生,极其神似.

lifelong.en: Building a memorial to Columbus has been his lifelong dream.
lifelong.cn: 为哥伦布建一座纪念碑是他一生的梦想。

lifelong.en: I've had a lifelong fascination with the sea and with small boats.
lifelong.cn: 我一生都对大海和小船着迷。

lifelong.en: Everyone knows that lifelong learning and reskilling are important.
lifelong.cn: 每个人都知道终身学习和不断学习新技术很重要。

lifetime.en: I want to take advantage of your lifetime of scholarship.
lifetime.cn: 我希望能够用到您一生的学识。

lifetime.en: I've spent a lifetime fighting against racism and prejudice.
lifetime.cn: 我一辈子都在同种族主义和偏见作斗争。

lifetime.en: Say's writings reached a wide audience during his lifetime.
lifetime.cn: 在塞伊有生之年，他的作品拥有大量的读者。

lift.en: The lift started off, juddered, and went out of action.
lift.cn: 电梯开动了，接着剧烈震颤起来，然后就毫无反应了。

lift.en: A bit of exercise will help lift his spirits.
lift.cn: 进行一点儿体育锻炼能帮助他改善情绪。

lift.en: I gave her a lift back out to her house.
lift.cn: 我让她搭我的便车回家。

light.en: The company manufactures a range of innovative light-weight cycles.
light.cn: 这家公司生产一系列的新型轻便自行车。

light.en: The light went out, and the room was plunged into darkness.
light.cn: 灯熄了，屋里陷入一片漆黑。

light.en: The builders have perched a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
light.cn: 建筑工人在8根细柱上架起轻巧的混凝土穹顶。

lighten.en: In sharing this secret you lighten your burden.
lighten.cn: 和别人分享这个秘密可以减轻自己的负担。

lighten.en: He managed to lighten the generally lifeless debate at times.
lighten.cn: 他让这场总体很沉闷的辩论时不时迸出了些火花。

lighten.en: An efficient bulb may lighten the load of power stations.
lighten.cn: 一个节能灯泡也许就能减轻发电站的负荷。

lighter.en: Giving an arsonist a lighter is beyond a joke.
lighter.cn: 把打火机交给纵火犯简直是不可理喻。

lighter.en: A problem for manufacturers is that lighter cars tend to be noisy.
lighter.cn: 制造商们遇到的一个问题是，重量较轻的汽车往往噪音大。

lighter.en: Modern tennis rackets are now apparently 20 per cent lighter.
lighter.cn: 现代的网球拍据说比以前的轻20%。

lighthearted.en: By merely letting drop one lighthearted remark, Miss Pao had Fang hooked.
lighthearted.cn: 鲍小姐只轻松一句话就把方鸿渐钩住了.

lighthearted.en: He had a lighthearted disposition and a soul filled with optimism.
lighthearted.cn: 他生性快活,心中无限乐观.

lighthearted.en: The children looked lighthearted now that the final exam was over.
lighthearted.cn: 期终考试结束了,孩子们看上去都很轻松愉快.

lighthouse.en: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse.
lighthouse.cn: 我的妻子戴着一顶看起来好象一座灯塔的帽子.

lighthouse.en: The lighthouse beam was quite distinct in the gathering dusk.
lighthouse.cn: 灯塔的光束在渐浓的暮色中清晰可见。

lightly.en: Despite his bulk he moved lightly on his feet.
lightly.cn: 尽管他身形庞大，移动起来还是很灵巧。

lightly.en: Put the onions in the pan and cook until lightly browned.
lightly.cn: 将洋葱放入平底锅内，炒至略呈棕色。

lightly.en: "Once a detective, always a detective," he said lightly.
lightly.cn: “一日为侦探，终生为侦探，”他满不在意地说。

lightness.en: "I'm not an authority on them," Jessica said with forced lightness.
lightness.cn: “我又不是这些方面的权威，”杰茜卡故作轻松地说。

lightness.en: The profundity of this book is achieved with breathtaking lightness.
She danced with a grace and lightness that were breathtaking.
lightness.cn: 她的舞跳得优雅轻盈，令人惊叹。

lightning.en: There was frequent thunder and lightning, and torrential rain.
It was unbelievably dramatic as lightning crackled all round the van.
lightning.cn: 闪电在货车周围炸开时，情景异常壮观。

lightning.en: Suddenly a bolt of lightning crackled through the sky.
lightning.cn: 突然一道闪电划破长空。

lightweight.en: Some of the discussion in the book is lightweight and unconvincing.
lightweight.cn: 书中的有些论述肤浅琐碎，毫无说服力。

lightweight.en: The vacant W.B.C. junior-lightweight title has been called off.
lightweight.cn: 空缺的世界拳击理事会次轻量级头衔被取消了。

lightweight.en: He changed from lightweight (under 71kg) to light middleweight (under 78kg).
lightweight.cn: 他从轻量级（71公斤以下）转到了轻中量级（78公斤以下）。

like.en: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
I thought you might like to read the enclosed.
like.cn: 我想你或许想要读一下信封里的内容。

like.en: He did not like to be caught out on details.
like.cn: 他不喜欢在细节上被人抓住把柄。

likelihood.en: The likelihood of infection is minimal.
There is very little likelihood of that happening.
likelihood.cn: 几乎没有发生那种事情的可能。

likelihood.en: He faces growing unease among the Democrats about the likelihood of war.
likelihood.cn: 他面临民主党内对可能出现的战事不断滋长的不满情绪。

likely.en: The fires are likely to permanently deforest the land.

longtime.cn: 我们同长期的盟友侯赛因国王的两次谈话与我们同伊斯梅乐的会晤是同等重要的.

longtime.en: A longtime relationship between business and government fosters collusion.
longtime.cn: 工商界和政府之间长期以来形成的一种关系助长两者之间的串通.

look.en: It was just then that I chanced to look round.
look.cn: 就在那时，我恰好环顾了下四周。

look.en: Does this dress make my legs look too stumpy?
look.cn: 这条裙子会使我的腿看上去又短又粗吗？

look.en: She had the look of someone deserted and betrayed.
look.cn: 她一副遭人遗弃和背叛的样子。

loom.en: As such tensions increase, they loom larger in Russia's domestic politics.
loom.cn: 这种紧张关系的不断加剧使其在俄罗斯国内政治中愈发凸显。

loom.en: He turned away from the messenger to work at his loom again.
loom.cn: 他撇下那两个捎口信的来者,又去织布.

loom.en: The old woman was weaving on her loom.
loom.cn: 那位老太太正在织布机上织布.

loop.en: These activists don't want to feel out of the loop.
loop.cn: 这些活跃分子不想做局外人。

loop.en: The road went in a huge loop around the lake.
loop.cn: 那条路环湖绕了一个大圈。

loop.en: I think that the vice president was in the loop.
loop.cn: 我认为副总统是局内人。

loose.en: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
loose.cn: 她把头发解开，让它随风飘动。

loose.en: She gathered loose soil and let it filter slowly through her fingers.
loose.cn: 她捧起疏松的泥土，任其缓缓地从指间漏下。

loose.en: She was pretty and young, in a loose smocked sundress.
loose.cn: 她年轻貌美，一身宽松的刺绣太阳裙。

loosely.en: The book follows four characters, loosely based on my uncles.
loosely.cn: 该书描述了4个角色，大致上以我的几个叔叔为原型。

loosely.en: The investigation had aimed at a loosely organised group of criminals.
loosely.cn: 调查针对一个组织松散的犯罪团伙展开。

loosely.en: A curl of black hair fell loosely across his forehead.
loosely.cn: 他的额头上垂着一绺散开的黑色卷发。

loosen.en: Relax, smile; loosen up in mind and body and behaviour.
loosen.cn: 放松，微笑。精神、身体和行为上都要放轻松。

loosen.en: Loosen the bolt so the bars can be turned.
loosen.cn: 松一松插销，好转动门闩。

loosen.en: Young people often loosen up on the dance floor.
loosen.cn: 年轻人常在舞池中放松自己。

looseness.en: This could occur as a result of some structural instability or looseness in the shell.
looseness.cn: 当外壳产生某些结构不稳定或松动时,就能产生这种情况.

looseness.en: Misunderstandings can often be traced to a looseness of expression.
looseness.cn: 误会常常源于疏于表达.

looseness.en: The flexibility and looseness of the materials from which mythology is made.
looseness.cn: 神话的取材往往随意灵活.

lop.en: We won the first game by a lop - sided score of 15 to 2.
lop.cn: 我们以15比2的悬殊比分赢了第一局.

lop.en: Entry into CC 1 Control Room is restricted to LOP field operators and LOP day staff.
lop.cn: 对于LOP现场的操作人员和LOP的 日班工作人员进入CC1是严格限制的.

lop.en: Who would marry a lop - sized ball man if they knew, right?
lop.cn: 谁会跟一个睾丸大小不一的人结婚, 对 吧 ?

lope.en: Lope de Aguirre: I am the wrath of God.
lope.cn: 阿奎尔: 我是上帝的愤怒.

lope.en: The deer went off at an easy lope.
lope.cn: 那鹿轻松地跳跃着去了.

lope.en: The hares and rabbits lope away.
lope.cn: 野兔和家兔都跳跃而去.

lopsided.en: The lopsided load on the lorry looked dangerous.
lopsided.cn: 货车上倾斜的货物,看样子很危险.

lopsided.en: He fixed me with a lopsided grin.
The article presents a somewhat lopsided view of events.
lopsided.cn: 这篇文章对事情的看法显得有些片面。

lord.en: His nine-month sentence was overturned by Appeal Court judge Lord Justice Watkins.
lord.cn: 上诉法院法官沃特金斯撤销了对他作出的9个月徒刑的判决。

lord.en: A few days earlier he had received a telegram from Lord Lloyd.
lord.cn: 几天前，他收到劳埃德勋爵发来的一封电报。

lord.en: "Good lord, that's what he is: he's a policeman."

lordly.en: Life had not taught her domination -- superciliousness of grace , which is the lordly power of some women.
lordly.cn: 她的生活经历使她和那些威风凛凛的夫人们不同,她身上没有专横和傲气.

lordly.en: There were a few lordly poplars before the house.
lordly.cn: 有一排白杨像贵族一样矗立在房子前.

lordly.en: The voice was rich, lordly, Harvardish, like all the boring radio comedians'imitations.
lordly.cn: 声音浑厚 、 威严, 俨然是哈佛出身的气派, 就跟无线电里所有的滑稽演员叫人已经听腻的模仿完全一样.

lore.en: They have become part of American business lore.
lore.cn: 小企业成了美国商业学上的一个重要章节.

lore.en: Carrie became wise in theatrical lore, hearing the gossip of little Lola.
lore.cn: 听着小萝拉的闲言碎语,嘉莉开始了解戏剧界的情况了.

lore.en: I could spice my talk with Talmudic lore, too.
lore.cn: 我还能够把一些犹太法典的知识融会于我的谈论之中.

lorry.en: He looked straight ahead and overtook a lumbering lorry.
lorry.cn: 他眼睛直视前方，加速超过了前面一辆慢吞吞行进的大卡车。

lorry.en: The lorry driver escaped unhurt, but a pedestrian was injured.
lorry.cn: 卡车司机安然脱险，但有一位行人受了伤。

lorry.en: They used a lorry to ram the main gate.

lose.en: Torn muscles retract, and lose strength, structure, and tightness.
lose.cn: 撕裂的肌肉会收缩，丧失原来的力量、结构和紧实度。

lose.en: Some battles you win, some battles you lose.
He appealed to his countrymen not to lose heart.
lose.cn: 他呼吁自己的同胞不要丧失信心。

loss.en: He always woke with a sense of deep sorrow and depressing loss.
loss.cn: 他醒来时总是满怀哀愁，抑郁惆怅。

loss.en: The gloom deepened after a thumping £45m loss at British Rail.
loss.cn: 英国铁路公司遭受了4,500万英镑的巨额损失后境况更加惨淡。

loss.en: Slimming snacks that offer miraculous weight loss are a con.
loss.cn: 有神奇减肥效果的瘦身点心是一个骗局。

lot.en: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
lot.cn: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

lot.en: Do you sweat a lot or flush a lot?
lot.cn: 你常出汗或是脸上常发烫吗？

lot.en: I got quite a lot of ribbing from my team-mates.
lot.cn: 队友们经常开我的玩笑。

lottery.en: Imagine winning the local lottery first prize of £5,000.
lottery.cn: 想象一下中个5,000英镑的当地彩票头奖吧。

lottery.en: She bought a lottery ticket and won more than $33 million.
lottery.cn: 她买了张彩票，中了3,300多万美元。

lottery.en: He won no less than ￡5000 in the lottery.
lottery.cn: 他居然中了5000英镑的奖券.

loud.en: There was a loud thump as the horse crashed into the van.
loud.cn: 马撞在货车上发出砰的一声巨响。

loud.en: Mr Jones received loud support from his local community.
loud.cn: 琼斯先生获得了他所在社区民众的热烈支持。

loud.en: I've always had a loud mouth, I refuse to be silenced.
loud.cn: 我一贯大声说出自己的想法，不会迫于压力而一言不发。

loudness.en: The amplitude of the vibration determines the loudness of the sound.
loudness.cn: 振动幅度的大小决定声音的大小.

loudness.en: His heart bumped in his breast with frightening loudness.
loudness.cn: 他的心在胸膛里怦怦怦地跳啊跳,声音响得好吓人.

loudness.en: The students began to enter the classroom and Anna was startled at their loudness.
loudness.cn: 学生们开始进入教室.安娜被他们的喧闹声吓了一跳.

loudspeaker.en: Their names were called over the loudspeaker .
loudspeaker.cn: 喇叭里叫着他们的名字。

loudspeaker.en: I distinctly heard the loudspeaker calling passengers for the Turin-Amsterdam flight.
loudspeaker.cn: 我清楚地听到扩音器里在请都灵至阿姆斯特丹航班的旅客登机。

loudspeaker.en: Announcements were made over the loudspeaker system.

lounge.en: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
lounge.cn: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

lounge.en: Let's meet in the cocktail lounge at the Hilton.
lounge.cn: 我们在希尔顿酒店的酒吧间碰头吧。

lounge.en: Clara had been reading in a lounge chair under a shady tree.
lounge.cn: 克拉拉一直坐在树阴下的躺椅上看书。

lounger.en: They knew only too well that any passer - by , any lounger, might be a spy.
lounger.cn: 她们非常清楚任何一个 过路人 或游手好闲者都可能告密.

lounger.en: This is where I thought the barca lounger could go!
lounger.cn: 这是我为你的懒汉躺椅安排的地方!

lounger.en: She eased herself out of the lounger and plopped down by the edge of the swimming - pool.
lounger.cn: 她从躺椅上起身,从池边扑通一声跳入泳池.

love.en: English has hurt me a thousand times, but I still regard it as my first love.
love.cn: 英语伤我千百遍，我待英语如初恋。

love.en: I will return, find you, love you, marry you and live without shame.
love.cn: 我会回去，找到你，爱你，娶你，活的光明正大。

love.en: If you love life, life will love you back.
love.cn: 热爱生活，生活也会厚爱你。(Arthur Rubinstein)

lovely.en: Sweden is lovely in summer— cold beyond belief in winter.
lovely.cn: 瑞典的夏天非常宜人——冬天却冷得让人难以置信。

lovely.en: "Such lovely clothes. I'd no idea Milan was so wonderful," she raved.
lovely.cn: “这些时装太漂亮了。我没想到米兰是如此的精彩，”她赞不绝口。

lovely.en: It was just one of those lovely old English gardens.
lovely.cn: 那正是一个那种古老的英式花园，非常迷人。

lover.en: She was dumped by her long-term lover after five years.
lover.cn: 5年后她被相恋多年的恋人抛弃了。

lover.en: He tried to throw police off the track of his lover.
lover.cn: 他努力让警方无法跟踪他的情人。

lover.en: Her lover walked out on her after she had aborted their child.
lover.cn: 她的情人在她打掉胎儿后甩了她。

low.en: Doctor believed that his low sperm count was the problem.
low.cn: 医生认为他的精子数太低是问题所在。

low.en: With a low-pitched rumbling noise, the propeller began to rotate.
low.cn: 伴随着隆隆的低沉噪声，螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

low.en: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground.
low.cn: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

lower.en: I felt a sharp pain in my lower back.
lower.cn: 我感觉到后腰一阵剧痛。

lower.en: Companies are moving jobs to towns with a lower cost of living.
lower.cn: 各公司正在把工作岗位转移至生活费用较低的城镇。

lower.en: Basal metabolism is much lower for creatures in cold water.
lower.cn: 冷水中生物的基础代谢速度要低很多。

lowland.en: Soon all lowland landscapes were left far behind them.
lowland.cn: 不一会,所有的低地景色都远远地消失在他们背后.

lowland.en: Successive regimes annexed the region and populated it with lowland people.
lowland.cn: 各继任政权吞并了该地区，并将低地的人们迁移到了这里。

lowland.en: Dikes protected the lowland from incursions of the sea.
lowland.cn: 堤防保护低地免于海水流入.

loyal.en: He has 20 years of loyal service to Barclays Bank behind him.
loyal.cn: 他已经忠心耿耿地为巴克莱银行效力了20年。

loyal.en: I thanked them for their long and loyal service.
loyal.cn: 我感谢他们长期以来忠诚的效力。

loyal.en: She was caustically brilliant, yet totally loyal, unpretentious, human and tolerant.
loyal.cn: 她这个人才气逼人，可是绝对忠诚可靠，而且毫不做作，有人情味和宽容心。

loyalist.en: The rebel forces have been repeatedly attacked by loyalist troops.
loyalist.cn: 叛军多次受到政府军的攻击.

loyalist.en: His report was scathing about Loyalist and Republican terror groups.
loyalist.cn: 他的报告猛烈抨击了忠英派和共和军的恐怖组织。

loyalist.en: Loyalist paramilitaries were blamed for the shooting.
loyalist.cn: 非法军事组织中的死硬分子被视为这起枪击事件的罪魁祸首。

loyally.en: She has loyally and unselfishly spent every day at her husband's side.
loyally.cn: 她每天都忠诚、无私地陪在她丈夫身边。

loyally.en: They have loyally supported their party and their leader.
loyally.cn: 他们忠诚地拥护他们的政党和领袖。

loyally.en: We will loyally uphold the principles of the United Nations.
loyally.cn: 我们将忠实地维护联合国的原则.

loyalty.en: Loyalty and support became the bywords of the day.
loyalty.cn: 忠诚和支持成了那个时代人们时常挂在嘴边的词儿。

loyalty.en: There were too many other demands on his loyalty now.
loyalty.cn: 现在还有太多其他的事情也要求他忠心。

loyalty.en: In his diary of 1944 he proclaims unswerving loyalty to the monarchy.
loyalty.cn: 他在1944年的日记里声称对君主忠贞不贰。

lubricant.en: I think humor is a great lubricant for life.
lubricant.cn: 我认为幽默是人生的上好润滑剂。

lubricant.en: Most mechanical devices require oil as a lubricant.
lubricant.cn: 绝大多数机械装置都需要用油作为润滑剂。

lubricant.en: Its nozzle was smeared with some kind of lubricant.
lubricant.cn: 它的喷嘴抹了某种润滑油。

lubricate.en: Franklin's task was to lubricate the discussions with the French.
lubricate.cn: 富兰克林的任务是促使与法国方面的会谈顺畅进行。

lubricate.en: Mineral oils are used to lubricate machinery.
lubricate.cn: 矿物油被用来润滑机器。

lubricate.en: Do not use emollients or oils to lubricate the skin.
lubricate.cn: 不要用润肤剂或油类来润滑皮肤。

luce.en: Lord Luce's capitulation to pressure from the Duke of Edinburgh has stored up huge problems for the future.
luce.cn: 卢斯勋爵迫于爱丁堡公爵的压力作了让步，为日后埋下了巨大隐患。

luce.en: Like many of his fellow , colonists Mr. Luce was a high or rather a deep conservative.
luce.cn: 像他一样的移民中,卢斯先生是许多偏激的――或者不如说是顽固的――保守分子中的一个.

luce.en: He could order a dinner almost as well as Mr. Luce.
luce.cn: 他点菜的本领几乎可以与卢斯先生媲美.

luck.en: He does deserve some good luck after so much wretchedness.
luck.cn: 经过这么多苦难之后，他应该行点好运了。

luck.en: Wood has not had much luck in carving out a career.
luck.cn: 伍德想干出点名堂来，可是总不能如愿。

luck.en: Good luck is when an opportunity comes along and you're prepared for it.
luck.cn: 好运就是当机会来临时，你早已做好了准备。

luckily.en: Luckily, Nancy's father and her attorney were one and the same person.
luckily.cn: 幸运的是，南希的父亲就是她的律师。

luckily.en: Luckily for me, he spoke very good English.
luckily.cn: 算我幸运，他英语讲得很好。

luckily.en: Luckily, I'd noticed where you left the car.
luckily.cn: 幸运的是我注意到了你把车停在哪里.

lucky.en: I'm lucky really as I never put on weight.
lucky.cn: 我很幸运，因为我的体重从来没有增加过。

lucky.en: Chantal was lucky to be able to salvage her career.
lucky.cn: 尚塔尔能保住她的事业算是走了运。

lucky.en: We're lucky to have such a man in our midst.
lucky.cn: 在我们中间有这样一个人是我们的幸运。

lucrative.en: He decided to turn his hobby into a lucrative sideline.
lucrative.cn: 他决定把自己的爱好变成赚钱的副业.

lucrative.en: It was quite a lucrative sideline.
a stepping stone to a more lucrative career
lucrative.cn: 涉足更赚钱的行业的敲门砖

lug.en: Nobody wants to lug around huge suitcases full of clothes.
lug.cn: 谁都不想拖着个装满衣服的大箱子到处走。

lug.en: Can I leave my bag somewhere? It's very heavy to lug around.
lug.cn: 我能在什么地方存一下包 吗 ?提着它到处走很重.

lug.en: I had to lug my bags up to the fourth floor.
lug.cn: 我只得费劲地把我的几个包拖上五楼。

luggage.en: They checked in their luggage and found seats in the departure lounge.
luggage.cn: 他们办完行李托运，到候机室找了座位坐下。

luggage.en: My rucksack was too big for the luggage rack.
luggage.cn: 我的背包太大了，行李架上放不下。

luggage.en: He waited until all the luggage was cleared, but Paula's never appeared.
luggage.cn: 他一直等到所有的行李都拿走了，但始终没看见葆拉的。

lull.en: There was a lull in political violence after the election of the current president.
lull.cn: 现任总统当选之后，政治暴力进入了一段暂时的平静期。

lull.en: Ground fighting flared up again after a two - week lull.
lull.cn: 经过两个星期的平静之后,地面战又突然爆发了.

lull.en: The drug put Simpson in a lull for thirty minutes.
lull.cn: 药物使辛普森安静了30分钟.

lumber.en: The truck was sent to carry lumber.
He was going to have to purchase all his lumber at full retail price.
lumber.cn: 他将不得不把所有木材按零售价分文不少地买下来。

lumber.en: It was made of soft lumber, spruce by the look of it.
lumber.cn: 其制作材料是软木，看起来像是云杉。

luminosity.en: For a few years its luminosity flared up to about 10,000 times the present-day luminosity of the Sun.
luminosity.cn: 它的亮度有几年一度达到了现在太阳亮度的一万倍左右。

luminosity.en: Mount Battie without losing its definition would take on a blue luminosity.
luminosity.cn: 远处的巴蒂山沉浸在一派蓝茫茫的暮蔼之中,轮廓朦胧.

luminosity.en: Astronomers tacitly assume that stars of the same luminosity and color all have the same mass.
luminosity.cn: 天文学家心照不宣地默认,光度和颜色都相同的恒星具有相同的质量.

luminous.en: He fixed me with those luminous, empty eyes and his melancholy smile.
luminous.cn: 他笑容忧郁地凝视着我，闪亮的眼睛里空无一物。

luminous.en: The desert was luminous, starkly beautiful.
luminous.cn: 沙漠里泛着光，有一种荒凉之美。

luminous.en: an alarm clock with a luminous dial

lump.en: They used to buy ten kilos of beef in one lump.
lump.cn: 他们过去常买10公斤重的整块牛肉。

lump.en: Howard had to have cancer surgery for a lump in his chest.
lump.cn: 霍华德不得不进行肿瘤手术以切除胸部的肿块。

lunar.en: The lunar stone is different from earth's.
lunar.cn: 月球的石头和地球的不同.

lunar.en: The astronauts piloted their craft down to the lunar surface.
lunar.cn: 宇航员驾驶太空飞船在月球表面降落.

lunar.en: The Spring Festival is the lunar New Year.

lunch.en: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week.
lunch.cn: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

lunch.en: We had lunch the other day at our favorite restaurant.
lunch.cn: 前两天我们在最喜欢的餐馆吃了午饭。

lunch.en: Use your lunch hour to have a nap in your chair.
lunch.cn: 利用午饭时间坐在椅子上打个盹吧。

luncheon.en: A casserole was already in the oven cooking gently for luncheon.
luncheon.cn: 焙盘菜已放在烤箱里慢慢煨着等午饭时吃.

luncheon.en: Luncheon will be served at one, Madam.
luncheon.cn: 夫人，午餐在一点钟开始。

luncheon.en: Promptly at one, luncheon was served.

minstrel.en: The young minstrel had a rare, rich voice.
minstrel.cn: 这个青年歌手有一幅稀有的嘹亮嗓音.

minstrel.en: The Negro minstrel is touring the country.
minstrel.cn: 那个黑人歌舞团正在全国各地巡回演出.

minstrel.en: A strong love has sprung up between the minstrel and the king.
minstrel.cn: 于是吟游诗人与国王之间就产生了深厚的感情.

mint.en: Combine the beans, chopped mint and olive oil in a large bowl.
mint.cn: 将菜豆、切碎的薄荷和橄榄油放在大碗里搅拌。

minus.en: The star's surface temperature is reckoned to be minus 75 degrees Celsius.
minus.cn: 这颗恒星的表面温度估计在零下75摄氏度左右。

minus.en: The film company collapsed, leaving Chris jobless and minus his life savings.
minus.cn: 电影公司垮了，克里斯没了工作，也失去了他一生的积蓄。

minus.en: None of these minus points will have been mentioned.
minus.cn: 这些不利因素都不会被提及。

minuscule.en: The film was shot in 17 days, a minuscule amount of time.
minuscule.cn: 这部电影仅用短短的17天便拍摄完毕。

minuscule.en: The human race only a minuscule portion of the earth's history.
minuscule.cn: 人类只有占有极小部分地球历史.

minuscule.en: The next few years are only a minuscule part of the equation.
minuscule.cn: 今后的几年只是其中很短的一段时间.

minute.en: The minute that the war started, everybody was glued to the television.
minute.cn: 战事一起，所有人都盯紧了电视报道。

minute.en: The Liberal Democrat'ssupport fell away at the last minute.
minute.cn: 自由民主党的支持率在最后一刻有所下降。

minute.en: He'd telephoned with some phoney excuse she didn't believe for a minute.
minute.cn: 他找了某个她根本不会相信的借口给她打电话。

minutely.en: They follow minutely the news from abroad on Cable News Network.
minutely.cn: 他们密切追踪有线电视新闻网上的国外新闻。

minutely.en: The metal is then minutely examined to ensure there are no cracks.
minutely.cn: 然后仔细检查了这块金属，以确保没有裂缝。

minutely.en: The benefit of an x-ray far outweighs the minutely increased risk of cancer.
minutely.cn: X光的好处远远大于其在很小程度上增加的罹患癌症的风险。

miocene.en: Those correspond to Quaternary , Pliocene , Upper Miocene, Lower Miocene and Eocene respectively.
miocene.cn: 分别为第四系 、 上新统、中新统上段 、 中新统下段及始新统.

miocene.en: There are four hydrocarbon source rocks, Palaeocene, Eocene, Oligocene and Miocene.
miocene.cn: 西湖凹陷发育古新统 、 始新统 、 渐新统及中新统四大烃源岩系.

miocene.en: Miocene formations ( better: strata ) are well - exposed in this area.
miocene.cn: 本区具有出露良好的中新世地层.

miracle.en: The Italian economic miracle has always been a mystery.
miracle.cn: 意大利的经济奇迹一直是个谜。

miracle.en: A miracle is something that seems impossible but happens anyway.
miracle.cn: 奇迹就是看似不可能，却发生了。

miracle.en: The 1981 budget was the springboard for an economic miracle.
miracle.cn: 1981年的预算促成了一场经济奇迹的出现。

miraculous.en: The story ascends from a gothic tragedy to a miraculous fairy-tale.
miraculous.cn: 故事从一个哥特式悲剧升华为神奇的童话。

miraculous.en: This figure has long been held to possess miraculous power.
miraculous.cn: 这个数字长时间以来都被认为拥有神奇的力量。

miraculous.en: Slimming snacks that offer miraculous weight loss are a con.
miraculous.cn: 有神奇减肥效果的瘦身点心是一个骗局。

mirage.en: It hovered before his eyes like the mirage of an oasis.
mirage.cn: 它在他眼前晃动，好像海市蜃楼里的绿洲。

mirage.en: The objectivity of science is a mirage.
mirage.cn: 所谓科学的客观性是一种幻想。

mirage.en: The girl was a mirage, cast up by his troubled mind.
mirage.cn: 那个女孩是他的幻觉，是他那忧郁不安的头脑妄想出来的。

mirror.en: Light colours provide an effective backdrop for pictures or a mirror.
mirror.cn: 浅色是挂放图画或镜子很有效果的衬托。

mirror.en: A mirror hung on a nail above the washstand.
mirror.cn: 脸盆架上方用钉子挂着一面镜子。

mirror.en: This is almost the mirror image of the situation in Scotland.
mirror.cn: 这几乎就是苏格兰局势的翻版。

miscalculation.en: An inadvertent agricultural policy miscalculation can also be costly.
miscalculation.cn: 农业政策上一个无意的失误,也会招致昂贵代价.

miscalculation.en: This fatal miscalculation lost them the final victory.
miscalculation.cn: 这个致命的错误估计使他们未能夺得最后胜利.

mischief.en: His eyes were full of mischief.
The letter had come from an unknown mischief-maker.
mischief.cn: 这封信来自一个匿名的离间者。

mischief.en: James Fox is best known as the author of White Mischief.
mischief.cn: 詹姆斯·福克斯以《欲望城》一书最为出名.

mischievous.en: She rocks back and forth on her chair like a mischievous child.
mischievous.cn: 她像个顽皮的孩子似的，坐在椅子上来回摇晃。

mischievous.en: Margaret was always mischievous and set on her own individual course.
mischievous.cn: 玛格丽特总是调皮捣乱，而且一意孤行。

mischievous.en: Berg tilts his head and a mischievous look crosses his face.
mischievous.cn: 伯格侧着头，脸上掠过一丝调皮的神情。

misconception.en: It is a misconception that Peggy was fabulously wealthy.
misconception.cn: 人们误以为佩吉相当有钱。

misconception.en: " To see every bush and tree on Mount Bagong as an enemy soldier " is an example of misconception.
misconception.cn: “ 八公山上,草木皆兵 ”,是错觉之一例.

misconception.en: It is a misconception to assume that the two continents are similar.
misconception.cn: 关于这两块大陆相似的假设是一种误解。

misdeed.en: I was to blame in part for this misdeed.
misdeed.cn: 对这个错误我要负部分责任.

misdeed.en: I am afraid he can not atone for all his misdeed.
misdeed.cn: 恐怕他无法抵偿他所有的罪行.

miser.en: The miser doesn't like to part with his money.
miser.cn: 守财奴舍不得花他的钱.

miser.en: The miser was untouched by the poor man's story.
miser.cn: 那个吝啬鬼对那穷人的叙述无动于衷.

miserable.en: Miserable, and unexpectedly lonely, she went in search of Jean-Paul.
miserable.cn: 内心痛苦、突感寂寞的她去寻找琼－保罗。

miserable.en: Our speed over the ground was a miserable 2.2 knots.
miserable.cn: 我们在接近地面时的航速仅为2.2节。

miserable.en: There was nothing at all in this miserable place to distract him.
miserable.cn: 这个鬼地方根本没有什么东西可以让他分心。

misfortune.en: He has known great misfortune in his life.
misfortune.cn: 他一生中经历过巨大的不幸。

misfortune.en: Some of my friends estranged themselves from me in my misfortune.
misfortune.cn: 我倒霉时,有些朋友就疏远了我.

misfortune.en: He had sympathy with those who were brought low by misfortune.
misfortune.cn: 对于那些因不幸而陷入贫困的人们他表示了同情.

misguided.en: These misguided people go around preaching up violence.
misguided.cn: 这些误入歧途的人到处鼓吹暴力.

misguided.en: In a misguided attempt to be funny, he manages only offensiveness.
misguided.cn: 他本想表现得风趣一点，却弄巧成拙地冒犯了别人。

misguided.en: She only did it in a misguided attempt to help.
misguided.cn: 她是要帮忙，只是想法不对头。

misinterpret.en: There is nothing of the kind in what they said; you always try to misinterpret the words of others.
misinterpret.cn: 他们说的绝不是那么一回事, 你总是想曲解别人的话.

misinterpret.en: Please allow me to assure you that you partially misinterpret my emotions.
misinterpret.cn: 请允许我向你说清楚,你部分地误解了我的感情.

misinterpret.en: It would be easy to misinterpret results from such a small sample.
misinterpret.cn: 从这样小的一份抽样出发容易得出曲解的结论.

mislead.en: Don't let his friendly words mislead you.
mislead.cn: 别让他那友好的言词把你蒙混住.

mislead.en: Macdonald accepted that such information could be used to manipulate, to obfuscate, and to mislead.
mislead.cn: 麦克唐纳相信这样的信息可以用来操纵舆论，蒙蔽误导。

mislead.en: Ministers must not knowingly mislead Parliament and the public.
mislead.cn: 大臣们不应该故意地误导议会与公众。

misled.en: Perhaps he had slightly misled them, but it was quite unintentional.
misled.cn: 也许他给他们造成了小小的误导，但他不是有意的。

misled.en: He deliberately misled us about the nature of their relationship.
misled.cn: 关于他们究竟是什么关系，他故意给我们留下错误印象。

misled.en: Jack was furious with his London doctors for having misled him.
misled.cn: 杰克对伦敦的医生欺骗自己的行为感到非常生气。

mismanage.en: The exigencies of forming may make it necessary to mismanage a pasture.
mismanage.cn: 生产过程中的突发性事件可能会迫使采取不适当的草场管理措施.

mismanagement.en: His economic mismanagement has lost him the support of the general public.
mismanagement.cn: 他对经济的管理不善使他失去了广大民众的支持。

mismanagement.en: A combination of operator mismanagement and design flaws caused the accident.
mismanagement.cn: 事故归因于操作人员处置失当,也归因于设计方面的漏洞.

mismanagement.en: A significant cause of mismanagement is the granting of authority without exacting responsibility.
mismanagement.cn: 管理不善的一个重要原因是只授予职权而不给明确责任.

mismatch.en: There is a mismatch between the skills offered by people and the skills needed by industry.
mismatch.cn: 行业需要的技术与人们可以提供的技能并不匹配。

mismatch.en: Are you discarding recent changes that led to the mismatch?
mismatch.cn: 还是放弃导致不匹配产生的最新改变?

mismatch.en: a mismatch between people's real needs and the available facilities
mismatch.cn: 人民的切实需要和现有设施之间的不协调

miss.en: She looked at Miss Melville, snugly ensconced among her new friends.
miss.cn: 她看了看梅尔维尔小姐，她正舒适地安坐在新朋友中间。

miss.en: It would be just his luck to miss the last boat.
miss.cn: 他就这运气，误了最后一班船也毫不出奇。

miss.en: At Miss Garbo's request there was a crema-tion after a private ceremony.
miss.cn: 应嘉宝小姐的要求，在私人悼念仪式结束后将进行火葬。

missile.en: The guidance systems didn't work and the missile couldn't hit its target.
missile.cn: 导航系统失灵，导弹未能命中目标。

missile.en: They claimed to have shot down one incoming missile.
missile.cn: 他们声称击落了一枚来犯的导弹。

missile.en: The plane was shot down in error by a NATO missile.
missile.cn: 一枚北约的导弹误将那架飞机击落。

missing.en: Ah yes, but think of all the family life they're missing.
missing.cn: 是这样，不过别忘了他们错过了多少天伦之乐。

missing.en: She was very glum and was obviously missing her children.
missing.cn: 她郁郁寡欢，显然在惦念自己的孩子们。

missing.en: It is not unknown for valuable display items to go, ahem, missing.
missing.cn: 贵重的展品，呃哼，丢失的话，会众人皆知。

mission.en: His function is vital to the accomplishment of the agency's mission.
mission.cn: 要完成该机构的使命，他的作用至关重要。

mission.en: There is an enormous sense of mission in his speech and gesture.
mission.cn: 他的一言一行都带着强烈的使命感。

mission.en: Their mission is simply to scout out places where helicopters can land.
mission.cn: 他们的任务只是找到能够让直升机着陆的地方。

missionary.en: She had a kind of missionary zeal about bringing culture to the masses.
missionary.cn: 她对于向大众传播文化有着满腔的热忱。

missionary.en: An American missionary was released today after more than two months of captivity.
missionary.cn: 一位美国传教士在被关押两个多月后于今天获释。

missionary.en: NB The opinions stated in this essay do not necessarily represent those of the Church of God Missionary Society.
missionary.cn: 请注意：文中所述观点并不代表传教会的立场。

mississippi.en: Like the Mississippi, it just keeps rolling along.
mississippi.cn: 它就像密西西比河河水一样不断地滚滚向前.

mississippi.en: The water level of the Mississippi River is already 6.5 feet below normal.
mississippi.cn: 密西西比河的水位已经比正常值低了6.5英尺。

mississippi.cn: 约瑟夫看到一群可疑的人在密西西比河的一艘轮船上打牌。

mississippian.en: In essence, this isopach map represents the simulated paleotopographic surface of the eroded Mississippian.
mississippian.cn: 实质上, 这张等厚图代表着遭到侵蚀的密西西比系的模拟古地形面.

missouri.en: She was born on a farm in Missouri in 1892.
missouri.cn: 她于1892年生于密苏里洲的一个农场主家庭.

missouri.en: In past presidential elections, Missouri has been a barometer of the rest of the country.
missouri.cn: 在过去的总统选举中，密苏里州一直是国内其他州的晴雨表。

missouri.en: He was trying to woo the daughter of a Missouri aris - tocrat.
missouri.cn: 他正试图追求一位密苏里的豪门小姐.

mist.en: With a thick mist now blanketing the trees, I got thoroughly lost.
mist.cn: 此时浓雾笼罩着林木，我彻底迷路了。

mist.en: I stepped outside and pulled up my collar against the cold mist.
mist.cn: 我走出门，竖起衣领抵御冷雾。

mist.en: He recognized the coast of England through a veil of mist.
mist.cn: 透过薄雾他认出了那是英格兰的海岸线。

mister.en: Mister, can we 'elp to carry yer stuff in?
mister.cn: 先生，要我们帮您把行李拿进去吗？

mister.en: Please, mister, can we have our ball back?
mister.cn: 求求你，先生，能把球还给我们吗？

mister.en: "That's right, mister," another child piped up.
mister.cn: “没错，先生，”另一个孩子突然说道。

mistress.en: She had always been mistress of her own destiny.
mistress.cn: 她总是能够掌握自己的命运。

mistress.en: Anthony sometimes felt that his mistress was his superior in will-power.
mistress.cn: 有时安东尼感觉他的情妇比他更有意志力。

mistress.en: We had a very good mathematics mistress who pulled me up.
mistress.cn: 我们有个很出色的女数学老师，她帮我提高了水平。

mistrust.en: There remains deep mistrust of his government.
mistrust.cn: 仍然有人对他领导的政府很不信任。

mistrust.en: I tended to mistrust my emotions and intellectualize everything.
mistrust.cn: 我往往不相信自己的情感，倾向于把一切事物都理智化。

mistrust.en: They expressed deep mistrust of the paper promises.
mistrust.cn: 他们对书面承诺表现出极度的不信任。

misty.en: They got misty-eyed listening to records of Ruby Murray singing "Danny Boy".
misty.cn: 聆听着唱片里鲁比·默里演唱《丹尼男孩》的时候，他们泪眼模糊。

misty.en: The cold, misty air felt wonderful on his face.
misty.cn: 雾蒙蒙的寒冷空气使他脸上感觉很舒爽。

misty.en: It's a bit misty this morning.

misunderstand.en: She no longer feared that they should misunderstand her.
misunderstand.cn: 她不再害怕他们会误解她了.

misunderstand.en: Don't misunderstand what I'm trying to say.
I'm not saying what he did was good, don't misunderstand me.
misunderstand.cn: 别误会，我并不是说他所做的是好事。

misunderstanding.en: There must be some misunderstanding—I thought I ordered the smaller model.
misunderstanding.cn: 一定是搞错了—我以为我订的是更小型号的。

misunderstanding.en: He was the unknowing cause of all the misunderstanding.
misunderstanding.cn: 他无意中引起了这一切误会。

misunderstanding.en: His misunderstanding of language was the primary cause of his other problems.
misunderstanding.cn: 他对语言的误解是引起其他问题的主要原因。

mite.en: I offer a mite of comfort to him.
He is a mite taller than I.
The poor mite was so ill.
mite.cn: 可怜的孩子病得这么重。

mitigate.en: Do our successes mitigate our failures?
mitigate.cn: 我们的成功是否能弥补我们的过失?

mitigate.en: Governments should endeavour to mitigate distress.
mitigate.cn: 政府应努力缓解贫困问题.

mitten.en: One red mitten lying lost under a poplar tree.
mitten.cn: 一只红色小猫迷惘地躺在白杨树下.

mitten.en: She has given her ex - boyfriend the mitten and married an old man.
mitten.cn: 她拒绝她以前的男朋友而嫁给了一个老头子.

mitten.en: There is a hole in the thumb of his mitten.
mitten.cn: 他的手套的拇指上有个洞.

mix.en: The song is a fiery mix of twanging guitar with relentless drumming.
mix.cn: 那是一首夹杂着撩拨的吉他声和密集的鼓点的激情四射的歌曲。

mix.en: Stewart has developed a tendency to mix it verbally with the opposition.
mix.cn: 斯图尔特现在变得只要和别人意见不合，就准备大吵一架。

mix.en: For speed we used packets of pizza dough mix.
mix.cn: 为了节约时间，我们用了几包做比萨饼的混合面粉。

mixer.en: You can take the mixer apart to clean it.
mixer.cn: 你可以把搅拌器拆开来清洁.

mixer.en: Cooper was a good mixer, he was popular.
mixer.cn: 库珀擅长交际，人缘很好。

mixer.en: This kind of mixer produces light, silky, even-textured batters.
mixer.cn: 这种搅拌机能搅拌出稀薄、柔滑、质地均匀的面糊。

mixture.en: The mixture can be used as a gargle several times a day.
mixture.cn: 每天可用这种混合液漱几次口。

mixture.en: The diaries are a mixture of confession, work in progress and observation.
mixture.cn: 这些日记里既有自白，也有当下工作记录，还有见闻评论。

mixture.en: Liquidize the mixture and then pass it through a sieve.
mixture.cn: 将混合物打成泥状，然后用滤网滤一下。

moan.en: You can go see him and have a good old moan.
moan.cn: 你可以去看看他，好好地诉诉苦。

moan.en: Suddenly she gave a low, choking moan and began to tremble violently.
moan.cn: 突然，她发出了一声低沉而哽咽的呻吟，然后剧烈地颤抖起来。

moan.en: I loathe negativity. I can't stand people who moan.
moan.cn: 我厌恶消极态度，不能忍受唉声叹气的人。

moat.en: A fire on the city gate brings disaster to the fish in the moat.
The Moat House stood not far from the rough forest road.
moat.cn: 莫特堡在距高低不平的森林大路没有多远的地方矗立着.

moat.en: The castle had a deep moat which emptied into the lake.
moat.cn: 城堡有一条很深的流入湖里的护城河.

mob.en: An unruly mob broke down police barricades and stormed the courtroom.
mob.cn: 一伙暴徒捣毁了警察设置的路障冲进法庭。

mob.en: Bottles and cans were hurled on the terraces by the mob.
mob.cn: 暴徒向看台扔瓶子和罐子。

mob.en: A mob of women laid into him with handbags and pointed shoes.
mob.cn: 一帮女人用手提包砸他，用鞋尖踢他。

mobile.en: The Party has been unable to attract upwardly mobile voters.
mobile.cn: 该党一直不能吸引那些追求更高社会地位的选民。

mobile.en: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
mobile.cn: 夏天一到，她的活动住房就变得像烤炉一样热。

mobile.en: Most mobile robots are still in the design stage.
mobile.cn: 大多数移动机器人仍处在设计阶段。

mobilise.en: India is now in a better position to mobilise its forces.
mobilise.cn: 印度现在更有条件动员军队了。

mobilise.en: With its command economy, China is able to mobilise resources on a massive scale at speed.
mobilise.cn: 由于其相对集中的经济体系, 中国可以高速地大规模调用资源.
