mobilise.cn: 此行的目的就是动员公众对这个备受争议的问题发表意见。

mobility.en: Prior to the nineteenth century, there were almost no channels of social mobility.
mobility.cn: 19世纪以前几乎不存在社会流动的渠道。

mobility.en: Mobility is very important in guerrilla warfare.
mobility.cn: 机动性在游击战中至关重要.

mobility.en: She has limited mobility in her arms.
mobility.cn: 她的双臂只能做有限的活动.

mobilize.en: Sudan even threat-ened to mobilize in response to the ultima-tums.

norway.cn: 很多挪威人认为就文化而言挪威是个年轻国家。

norway.en: His name was Hansen, a common name in Norway.
norway.cn: 他的名字叫汉森，在挪威是一个常见的名字。

norwegian.en: I stood there breathing in the fresh Norwegian air.
norwegian.cn: 我站在那儿呼吸着挪威新鲜的空气。

norwegian.en: Norwegian whalers said yesterday they had harpooned a female minke whale.
norwegian.cn: 挪威的捕鲸人说昨天他们用捕鲸叉捕获了一头雌性小须鲸。

norwegian.en: 1,654 passengers were transferred at sea to a Norwegian cruise ship.
norwegian.cn: 1,654名乘客在海上转搭了一艘挪威游轮。

nose.en: She wrinkled her nose, piqued by his total lack of enthusiasm.
nose.cn: 她皱皱鼻子，为他毫无热情而感到不快。

nose.en: He had had a fight with Smith and bloodied his nose.
nose.cn: 他和史密斯打了一架，把后者的鼻子打出了血。

nose.en: Barry had his nose put out of joint by Lucy's aloof sophistication.
nose.cn: 露西的冷淡与世故使得巴里十分不快。

nostalgia.en: The images provoked strong surges of nostalgia for the days of yore.
nostalgia.cn: 这些影像勾起了对昔日时光的强烈怀念。

nostalgia.en: She wallows in nostalgia for the past.
nostalgia.cn: 她沉湎于对过去的怀恋.

nostalgia.en: Many people look back with nostalgia to feudal times.
nostalgia.cn: 许多人留恋不舍地回顾封建时代.

nostalgic.en: Many people were nostalgic for the good old days.
nostalgic.cn: 很多人都很留恋过去的好时光。

nostalgic.en: He made a nostalgic return visit to Germany.
nostalgic.cn: 他满怀怀旧之情重访德国。

nostalgic.en: Somehow the place even smelt wonderfully nostalgic.
nostalgic.cn: 不知为什么，这个地方竟透出一种浓郁的怀旧气息。

nostril.en: The nose : beautifully formed otherwise, was very slightly pinched at the top of each nostril.
nostril.cn: 那鼻子若不是在两道鼻翼上略微凹下了些,便可以算得上漂亮.

nostril.en: On the paralyzed side the ear is pendulous, the eye partly closed, and the nostril immobilized.
nostril.cn: 在麻痹的一侧,耳下垂; 眼半闭, 鼻孔不运动.

nostril.en: There was the same refinement of brow and nostril in both.
nostril.cn: 两人的额头和鼻梁同样细嫩.

nosy.en: I agree that the press is often too nosy about a candidate's personal history.
nosy.cn: 的确，媒体常常过分关注候选人的个人经历。

nosy.en: Don't be so nosy—it's none of your business.
nosy.cn: 别管那么多闲事—这与你无关。

nosy.en: He was having to whisper in order to avoid being overheard by their nosy neighbours.
nosy.cn: 他不得不小声说，免得被爱管闲事的邻居们听到。

not.en: The happiest are not those who own all the best things, but those who can appreciate the beauty of life.
not.cn: 最幸福的人们并不一定什么都是最好，只是他们懂得欣赏生活的美好。

not.en: Success is not guaranteed. It is not handed to you. Success is earned.
not.cn: 成功无法保证，并非唾手可得。成功必须靠自己去争取。

not.en: Do not wait for good things to happen to you. You need to walk towards happiness.
not.cn: 不要等待好事降临，你要向幸福进发。

notable.en: Several notable researchers are studying the effects of hyperventilation.
notable.cn: 几位著名的研究人员正在研究通气过度的后果。

notable.en: She became quite a notable director in the thirties and forties.
notable.cn: 她在三四十年代成了一位名导演。

notable.en: Tuesday's notable gainer was Sony, which reached a high of 9,070 yen.
notable.cn: 星期二的大赢家为索尼公司，其股票上涨至9,070日元的高点。

notably.en: The house had many drawbacks, most notably its price.
notably.cn: 这房子有很多缺陷，尤其是它的价格。

notably.en: There are other forms of civil disorder — most notably, football hooliganism.
notably.cn: 还有其他形式的民众骚乱，最出名的是足球流氓行为。

notably.en: This show has several strengths — notably a strong cast.
notably.cn: 这个表演有一些亮点——尤其是演员阵容特别强大。

notate.en: The question is when and how to notate them.
notate.cn: 问题是何时以及你如何以符号来表示它们。

notation.en: Using binary notation is in fact just manipulating ones and noughts.
notation.cn: 使用二进制标号法实际上只运用1和0两个数.

notation.en: Music has a special system of notation.
notation.cn: 音乐有一套特殊的标记法.

notation.en: Musical notation was conceived for the C major scale and each line and space represents a note in this scale.
notation.cn: 五线谱以C大音阶构成，每一个线和间代表这个音阶的音符。

notch.en: A sesame stalk puts forth blossoms notch by notch, higher and higher.
He is keen to notch up yet another success.
The quality of the food here has dropped a notch recently.
notch.cn: 这里的饭菜质量最近下降了一级。

note.en: She scribbled a note to tell Mum she'dgone out.
note.cn: 她匆匆写了个便条告诉妈妈她已外出。

note.en: Somehow he tells these stories without a note of horror.
note.cn: 不知为什么他讲这些故事时一点都不害怕。

note.en: She had written him a note a couple of weeks earlier.
note.cn: 她几周前给他写过一个便条。

notebook.en: He took my name and address, scribbling it down in his notebook.
notebook.cn: 他要了我的姓名和地址，匆匆写在他的笔记本上。

notebook.en: Tamsin materialized at her side, notebook at the ready.
notebook.cn: 塔姆辛从她身旁冒了出来，且备好了笔记本。

notebook.en: Prue entered the passage in her notebook, then read it aloud again.
notebook.cn: 普吕把那一段写在她的笔记本上，然后又大声念了一遍。

noted.en: Haig noted how he "looked pinched and rather tired".
noted.cn: 黑格注意到了他“看上去消瘦，非常劳累”的样子。

noted.en: Its books are noted for the quality of their paper and bindings.
noted.cn: 其图书以纸质优良、封面精美而闻名。

noted.en: Official handouts describe the Emperor as "particularly noted as a scholar".
noted.cn: 官方印发的材料将皇帝描述为“尤以学识渊博而著称”。

noteworthy.en: I found nothing particularly noteworthy to report.
noteworthy.cn: 我并无特别重要的事情要报告。

noteworthy.en: The bridge is noteworthy for its sheer size.
Use bold type for headings and bullet points for noteworthy achievements.
noteworthy.cn: 标题使用粗黑字体，显著的成就要用着重号标示。

nothing.en: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough.
I know it's nothing serious and I feel quite unemotional about it.
nothing.cn: 我知道那根本没什么大不了的，所以有些无动于衷。

nothing.en: Beauty is an attitude. It has nothing to do with age.
nothing.cn: 美是一种态度，与年龄无关。

notice.en: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
notice.cn: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

notice.en: Interest is paid monthly. Three months' notice is required for withdrawals.
notice.cn: 利息按月支付。提款须提前3个月通知银行。

notice.en: It's not a case of whether anyone would notice or not.
notice.cn: 这不是会不会有人注意到的问题。

noticeable.en: The carpet of leaves in my yard became more and more noticeable.
noticeable.cn: 我的院子里的落叶越来越厚。

noticeable.en: There's also been a noticeable rise in the political temperature.
noticeable.cn: 政治气氛也明显升温了。

noticeable.en: Many people in Minnesota and Tennessee have noticeable regional accents.
noticeable.cn: 明尼苏达州和田纳西州的许多人都有明显的地区口音。

noticeably.en: Douglas was noticeably silent about his feelings for his father.
noticeably.cn: 道格拉斯明显不愿提及自己对父亲的感情。

noticeably.en: The articles are noticeably shorter with strong headlines and graphics.
noticeably.cn: 这些文章明显短了许多，并且配上了醒目的标题和图表。

noticeably.en: She has one slightly withered leg, noticeably thinner than the other.
noticeably.cn: 她有一条腿有点儿萎缩，看上去明显比另一条腿瘦。

notification.en: Names of the dead and injured are being withheld pending notification of relatives.
notification.cn: 在正式通知亲属前，伤亡人员名单暂时保密。

notification.en: Payments should be sent with the written notification.
notification.cn: 支付款应该随书面通知寄出。

notification.en: Can you give us some notification?
notification.cn: 请给我们发个通知好 吗 ?

notify.en: He will notify us where we are to meet.
notify.cn: 他将通知我们在什么地方集合.

notify.en: The court clerk will notify the witness when and where to appear.
notify.cn: 法院办事员将通知证人出庭的时间及地点.

notify.en: I don't suppose it occurred to you to notify the police.
notify.cn: 我看你没想过要去通知警察。

notion.en: The very notion of price competition is foreign to many schools.
notion.cn: 价格竞争这个概念对于许多学校都很陌生。

notion.en: Their relationship turned the standard notion of marriage on its head.
notion.cn: 他们的关系完全颠覆了传统的婚姻观念。

notion.en: The notion that art should be controlled by intellectuals sickened him.
notion.cn: 他讨厌艺术应由知识分子所掌控的观点。

notorious.en: He is notorious for making unexpected, often self-contradictory, comments.
notorious.cn: 他发表的那些出人意料而且经常自相矛盾的评论令他臭名昭著。

notorious.en: This town is notorious for chewing people up and spitting them out.
notorious.cn: 这个城市恶名昭彰，它把人作践了，然后抛弃掉。

notorious.en: The accident happened on a notorious black spot on the A43.
notorious.cn: 事故发生在A43号公路上一个出了名的事故多发地段。

notwithstanding.en: His relations with colleagues, differences of opinion notwithstanding, were unfailingly friendly.
notwithstanding.cn: 尽管有意见分歧，他和同事们一直关系融洽。

notwithstanding.en: He despised William Pitt, notwithstanding the similar views they both held.
notwithstanding.cn: 尽管他和威廉·皮特看法相似，却瞧不起他。

notwithstanding.en: Notwithstanding some major financial problems, the school has had a successful year.
notwithstanding.cn: 虽然有些重大的经费问题，这所学校一年来还是很成功。

nought.en: Numerous attempts to persuade him to write his memoirs came to nought.
nought.cn: 无数次劝他写回忆录的尝试均以失败告终。

nought.en: Sales rose by nought point four per cent last month.
Any number to the power of nought is equal to one.

noun.en: The word " person " is a countable noun.
noun.cn: person 这个词是个可数名词.

noun.en: The noun " mouse " is the singular form of " mice " .
noun.cn: 名词mouse是 mice 的单数形式.

noun.en: In " the black cat " the adjective " black " modifies the noun " cat " .
noun.cn: 在the black cat这一词组中,形容词 black 修饰名词cat.

nourish.en: Journalists on the whole don't create public opinion. They can help to nourish it.
nourish.cn: 大体说来记者不制造舆论。他们会助长舆论。

nourish.en: They needed good food to nourish their bodies.
nourish.cn: 他们需要好食品滋养身体.

nourish.en: We need good food to nourish the starving infants.
nourish.cn: 我们需要好食品滋养这些挨饿的婴儿.

nourishment.en: The mother provides the embryo with nourishment and a place to grow.
nourishment.cn: 母亲为胎儿提供营养和成长的空间。

nourishment.en: To help provide essential nourishment, we've put together these nutritious drinks.
nourishment.cn: 为了帮助提供必要的营养，我们调配了这些营养饮料。

nourishment.en: Sugar gives quick relief to hunger but provides no lasting nourishment.
nourishment.cn: 糖能快速缓解饥饿感，但不能提供持久的营养。

nouveau.en: This design includes organic curves and a hint of Art Nouveau styling.
nouveau.cn: 这个设计包括了有机曲线和少许新艺术主义式样.

nouveau.en: The nouveau riche have to find a way to be accepted.
nouveau.cn: 暴发户不得不去想法获得大家的接受和认可。

nouveau.en: Architecture form emerged in Art Nouveau is called " Modernism " in Spain.
nouveau.cn: 新艺术运动中出现的建筑形式,在西班牙被称为 “ 现代式”,而巴塞罗那则汇聚了 “ 现代式”建筑的主要作品.

novel.en: The various elements of the novel fail to cohere.
novel.cn: 这部小说的各部分之间缺乏连贯性。

novel.en: The scriptwriter helped him to adapt his novel for the screen.
novel.cn: 编剧帮助他将其所著小说改编成电影。

novel.en: D H Lawrence immortalised her in his novel "Women in Love". D.H.
novel.cn: 劳伦斯在小说《恋爱中的女人》中把她塑造成了一个不朽的角色。

novelist.en: A novelist creates characters and a plot.
novelist.cn: 小说家塑造人物并设计情节.

novelist.en: Faulkner has been hailed as the greatest American novelist of his generation.
novelist.cn: 福克纳被誉为他那一代人中最伟大的美国小说家。

novelist.en: Helen is a very well-known novelist in Australia.
novelist.cn: 海伦是澳大利亚非常著名的小说家。

novelty.en: They're treating it like a game, a novelty. That's got to stop.
novelty.cn: 他们把这件事当成了一个游戏，觉得很新鲜。不能再那样下去了。

novelty.en: There's a certain novelty value in this approach.
novelty.cn: 这种方法有一定的新意。

novelty.en: Having a mid-morning party certainly adds novelty value.
novelty.cn: 在上午10点左右开派对一定会增加新鲜感。

november.en: He only got a plurality on November 3rd, just 49 percent.
november.cn: 他在11月3号的选举中仅获得了49%的相对多数票。

november.en: He was bailed to appear before local magistrates on 5 November.
november.cn: 他获得保释，将于11月5日在地方法庭出庭受审。

november.en: Troops were sent to the islands to restore order last November.
november.cn: 去年11月，军队被派往这些岛屿以恢复秩序。

novice.en: I'm a novice at these things, Lieutenant. You're the professional.
novice.cn: 中尉，做这些事情我是新手，你是行家。

novice.en: I'm a complete novice at skiing.
He's still a novice as far as film acting is concerned.
novice.cn: 就电影表演而言他仍是新手.

now.en: A journalist all his life, he's now brought out a book.
now.cn: 他当了一辈子新闻记者，如今已出了一本书。

now.en: He will now face a disciplinary hearing for having an affair.
now.cn: 他因有外遇而要面临纪律听证会的裁决。

now.en: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes.
now.cn: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

nowadays.en: The term "early retirement" is nearly always a euphemism for redundancy nowadays.
nowadays.cn: 现在“提前退休”几乎就是裁员的委婉说法。

nowadays.en: People live longer nowadays, and they are better educated.
nowadays.cn: 当今，人们越来越长寿，受教育程度也提高了。

nowadays.en: You're miles better than most of the performers we see nowadays.
nowadays.cn: 你比当下我们见到的大多数表演者都强多了。

nowhere.en: The bowlers at the eye of the storm were nowhere in evidence.
nowhere.cn: 处于风口浪尖的那些投手不见了踪影。

nowhere.en: These rootless young people have nowhere else to go.
nowhere.cn: 这些漂泊不定的年轻人没有其他地方可去。

nowhere.en: Houses had sprung up out of nowhere on the hills.
nowhere.cn: 山丘上突然冒出一幢幢的房子。

noxious.en: Noxious gases had built up in the sewer.
noxious.cn: 下水道的有害气体越积越多.

noxious.en: Heavy industry pollutes our rivers with noxious chemicals.
noxious.cn: 重工业产生的有毒化学品会污染我们的河流。

nozzle.en: The rubber nozzle is all cracked.
Its nozzle was smeared with some kind of lubricant.
nozzle.cn: 它的喷嘴抹了某种润滑油。

nozzle.en: She turned the nozzle and the spray concentrated down to a stream.
nozzle.cn: 她掉转喷嘴,让水花集中喷入小河.

nuclear.en: They have removed all tactical nuclear missiles that could strike Europe.
nuclear.cn: 他们已经拆除所有能够袭击欧洲的战术核导弹。

nuclear.en: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
nuclear.cn: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

nuclear.en: Nuclear weapons plants across the country are heavily contaminated with toxic wastes.
nuclear.cn: 全国的核武器工厂均受到了有毒废弃物的严重污染。

nucleic.en: The capsid together with the enclosed nucleic acid is the nucleocapsid.
nucleic.cn: 衣壳同包围它的核酸一起称为核衣壳.

nucleic.en: Ribose and deoxyribose are constituents of the nucleic acids RNA and DNA.
nucleic.cn: 核糖与脱氧核糖分别是核糖核酸与脱氧核酸(DNA)的结构成分.

nucleic.en: He recruited another nucleic acid chemist, a young Pakistani, Dr. Rao Sastri.
nucleic.cn: 他又找来一名核酸化学家, 叫作拉奥·萨斯特利的年轻的巴基斯坦人.

nucleus.en: The repulsive force within the nucleus is enormous.
nucleus.cn: 核子内部的斥力是巨大的。

nucleus.en: These paintings will form the nucleus of a new collection.
nucleus.cn: 这些画将构成新的收藏系列的基础。

nude.en: Would you turn down $7,000,000 to appear nude in a magazine?
nude.cn: 给你700万美元要你裸体登上杂志，你会拒绝吗？

nude.en: She turned down £1.2 million to pose nude in Playboy.
nude.cn: 她拒绝了为《花花公子》杂志拍摄裸照的120万英镑开价。

nuisance.en: It's a blooming nuisance because it frightens my dog to death.
nuisance.cn: 它真让人讨厌，快把我的狗吓死了。

nuisance.en: He spent three days making an absolute nuisance of himself.
nuisance.cn: 他3天时间就把自己变成了个地地道道的“讨人嫌”。

nuisance.en: Back in the 1980s drug users were a public nuisance in Zurich.
nuisance.cn: 在20世纪80年代，吸毒者在苏黎世是被众人所唾弃的。

numb.en: He could feel his fingers growing numb at their tips.
numb.cn: 他能感到指尖正在变得麻木。

numb.en: First he had been numb. Then the numbness gave way to anger.
numb.cn: 起初他只是麻木，接着转为了愤怒。

numb.en: Numb with terror, she stared at the departing maraud-ers.
numb.cn: 她吓得呆若木鸡，眼睁睁地看着劫匪们离去。

number.en: And a number of African countries, too, are slipping through the net.
number.cn: 并且一些非洲国家也被漏掉了。

number.en: Accidents are still the number one cause of premature death for Americans.
number.cn: 交通事故仍然是造成美国人过早死亡的头号因素。

number.en: There must be any number of people in my position.
number.cn: 一定有很多人处在我这种境况。

numeral.en: A table comparing numerals in two different numeral systems.
numeral.cn: 一种可以比较两种不同数制中的数字的表格.

numeral.en: Our own numeral system is an example of a positional numeral system with base 10.
numeral.cn: 我们现在所用的数系就是以10为基的定位数系.

numeral.en: This numeral means a onefold increase in production.
numeral.cn: 这个数字意味着产量提高了一倍.

numeric.en: The instructions of the program have to be written in a numeric form.
numeric.cn: 程序的指令需要写成数字形式.

numeric.en: A programming language based on ALGOL and designed for non - numeric manipulation of mathematical expressions.
numeric.cn: 一种以ALGOL语言为基础,为数学表达式进行 非 数值操作而设计的程序设计语言.

numeric.en: A generic name for a device that can store and process numeric and alphabetic in formation.
numeric.cn: 能存储和处理数字与字母信息的设备的总称.

numerical.en: This consolidation meant having to reduce the numerical strength of the Army.
numerical.cn: 这次合并意味着不得不削减陆军的兵力。

numerical.en: The numbers are in numerical order.
numerical.cn: 这些号码是按数字顺序排列的.

numerical.en: The results are expressed in descending numerical order .

numerous.en: This year numerous bands are playing, as well as comedy acts.
numerous.cn: 今年除了那些搞笑短剧外，还会有众多乐队登台献艺。

numerous.en: The doctors gave numerous examples of patients being expelled from hospital.
numerous.cn: 医生们列举了大量病人被逐出医院的实例。

numerous.en: Scientific development meant the growth of numerous professions ancillary to medicine.
numerous.cn: 科技发展意味着许多医学衍生职业的增长。

nun.en: It has confirmed me in my decision not to become a nun.
nun.cn: 这使我更加坚定了不做修女的决心。

nun.en: Finally, late in life and against considerable odds, she became a nun.
nun.cn: 她排除极大困难，最终在晚年成为了一名修女。

nun.en: I can't believe that the famous singer has become a nun.
nun.cn: 我无法相信那个著名的歌星已做了修女.

nurse.en: We're going to go home and nurse our colds.
nurse.cn: 我们打算回家调养感冒。

nurse.en: She volunteered as a nurse in a soldiers' rest-home.
nurse.cn: 她自告奋勇到士兵疗养院当护士。

prolong.cn: 他已决定把他的访问延长到过完周末.

prolong.en: The operation could prolong his life by two or three years.
prolong.cn: 这次手术可使他多活两三年。

prolonged.cn: 经济长期疲软可能会对固特异公司造成影响。

prolonged.cn: 保罗延长了他的受教育时间，打算花6年时间深造英语。

prominence.en: An item of prominence on the conference agenda was infant health care.
prominence.cn: 会议议程上的一项重要议题是婴儿保健.

prominence.cn: 最近崭露头角的一名年轻演员

prominence.en: Crime prevention had to be given more prominence.
prominence.cn: 防止犯罪方面应当受到更多的重视。

prominent.cn: 花园里，苹果树和梨树患枯枝病最明显。

prominent.en: His stomach had grown more prominent with every passing year.
prominent.cn: 他的肚子一年比一年鼓。

prominent.cn: 通过对著名活动家进行政治审判使其从公众视线中消失。

promise.en: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in grade school.
promise.cn: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。

promise.en: President Kaunda fulfilled his promise of announcing a date for the referendum.
promise.cn: 卡翁达总统兑现了他的承诺，宣布了全民公决的日期。

promise.en: I'm hoping you'll keep your promise to come for a long visit.
promise.cn: 我希望你遵守诺言来这儿多呆几天。

promising.en: This small part was taken with elan by a promising young tenor.
promising.cn: 这一小段由一位大有前途的青年男高音倾情演绎。

promising.cn: 这张令人难堪的照片是怎么落到媒体手中的？

promising.cn: 西印度群岛的板球运动看起来前景光明。

promote.en: It's simply unethical to promote and advertise such a dangerous product.
promote.cn: 宣传推广如此危险的产品完全是不道德的。

promote.en: She refused to promote Colin above the low rank of "legal adviser".
promote.cn: 她拒绝把科林由“法律顾问”这一低级别往上提。

promote.en: They have begun dialogues to promote better understanding between both communities.
promote.cn: 双方已经开始了对话，以增进两个社群间的彼此了解。

promoter.en: The promoter matched the young boxer with a more skillful fighter.
promoter.cn: 拳击竞赛主办者让这位年轻拳击手和技术更娴熟的拳师较量.

promoter.en: Aaron Copland was an energetic promoter of American music.
promoter.cn: 阿伦·科普兰从来都是美国音乐的积极倡导者。

promoter.en: She became a leading promoter of European integration.
promoter.cn: 她成为欧洲一体化的主要支持者。

promotion.en: Her independence and maverick behaviour precluded any chance of promotion.
promotion.cn: 她的独立精神和自行其是断送了一切升迁的机会。

promotion.en: The advertising campaign will be supported by a PR and below-the-line promotion.
promotion.cn: 广告宣传活动将采取公关和线下促销的形式。

promotion.en: The government has pledged to give the promotion of democracy higher priority.
promotion.cn: 政府已经保证把促进民主摆在更重要的位置。

promotional.en: He is hawking around a 15-minute, £5,000 promotional video.
promotional.cn: 他正在四处推销一部长15分钟、价值5,000英镑的宣传录像片。

promotional.en: This will give your promotional material individuality and style.
promotional.cn: 这会让你的促销品显得个性十足、格调高雅。

promotional.en: Some companies have toned down the claims on their promotional literature.

promptly.cn: 弗朗西丝卡修女走进小教堂，坐下来，很快就睡着了。

prone.cn: 细胞变小后就会更容易感染疾病，也更容易死亡。

proof.cn: 他不得不收回他说过的公司能免受经济衰退影响的话。

propagate.cn: 大多数植物都是通过种子繁殖的.

propagate.cn: 那个政党创办一份报纸来宣传该党的观点.

propagate.en: Insects propagate themselves by means of eggs.

propagation.cn: 玫瑰繁殖有着悠久的历史。

properly.cn: 合适的胸罩不会留下红色勒痕。

proponent.cn: 哈尔西被认为是进步教育价值观的主要拥护者。

proponent.cn: 前者最重要的代表人物是德克利夫太太.

proportion.cn: 人口中有一大部分说以法语为基础的混合语。

proportion.en: The proportion of women in the profession had risen to 17.3%.
proportion.cn: 从事该职业的女性比例已升高到17.3%。

proportional.cn: 那侏儒的长臂与他的身高不成比例.

proportional.cn: 工资的增长与物价的上涨是成比例的.

proprietor.cn: 他现在一个人拥有这家公司.

propriety.en: Nobody questioned the propriety of her being there alone.
propriety.cn: 没人认为她只身出现在那里不得体。

propulsion.cn: 19世纪船舶设计和船舶动力领域发生了重大的变革。

propulsion.en: The liquids employed for rocket propulsion are called propergols.
propulsion.cn: 用于火箭发动机的液体称为液体火箭推进剂.

radical.en: This thesis led to a radical reshaping of Labour policies.
radical.cn: 这篇论文导致了工党政策的彻底改变。

radical.en: There will be a radical swing to the right or the left.
radical.cn: 将出现极左或极右的情况。

radically.en: The health service must be radically reformed.
radically.cn: 公共医疗卫生服务必须进行彻底改革.

radically.en: I think we may have to rethink our policies fairly radically.
radically.cn: 我认为我们可能要对我们的政策进行根本的反思.

radically.en: Something is radically amiss in our health care system.
radically.cn: 我们的保健制度存在重大缺陷。

radioactive.en: Wine is radioactive but few people stop drinking it on that account.
radioactive.cn: 酒是有放射性的，可是很少有人因此而戒酒。

radioactive.en: The government has been storing radioactive waste at Fernald for 50 years.
radioactive.cn: 政府在弗纳德存放放射性废料已达50年之久。

radioactive.en: The waste is safely locked away until it is no longer radioactive.
radioactive.cn: 废料被安全储存起来，直到其不再有辐射性。

radioactivity.en: the process of decontaminating areas exposed to radioactivity
radioactivity.cn: 清除受放射污染地区有害物质的过程

radioactivity.en: The soil contains 30 times the acceptable level of radioactivity.
radioactivity.cn: 这片土壤受到了高于标准30倍的辐射.

radioactivity.en: The site was found to be contaminated by radioactivity.
radioactivity.cn: 发现此地受放射线污染.

radiocarbon.en: The material in this beach has been dated by radiocarbon.
radiocarbon.cn: 这个海滩上的物质经过放射性碳测定.

radiocarbon.en: The most frequently used method is radiocarbon dating.
radiocarbon.cn: 最常用的方法是放射性碳定年法。

radiocarbon.en: The leaf was allowed to photosynthesize in the presence of radiocarbon.
radiocarbon.cn: 叶子被允许同放射性碳进行光合作用.

radish.en: A spicy , sharp - tasting radish was exactly what her stomach craved.
radish.cn: 她正馋着想吃一个香甜可口的红萝卜呢.

radish.en: The blade of this knife is so dull that it will not cut a radish.
radish.cn: 这把刀的刀刃太钝，不能切萝卜。

radium.cn: 在开始讨论这次演讲的话题之前, 我还想回忆一下,镭和钋发现是皮埃尔·居里与我合作完成的.

radium.en: Radon is the daughter of radium.
Radium can be used to treat cancer.

raft.en: The raft gathered speed as the current dragged it toward the falls.
raft.cn: 水流将木筏拽向瀑布，木筏的速度越来越快。

raft.en: I made for the life raft and hung on for dear life.
raft.cn: 我游到救生筏前，死命地抓住它。

raft.en: The crew spent two days and nights in their raft.
raft.cn: 船员在救生筏上呆了两天两夜。

rag.en: He was wiping his hands on an oily rag.
rag.cn: 他正在用一块满是油污的破布擦手。

rag.en: "This man Tom works for a local rag," he said.
rag.cn: “这个叫汤姆的人在一家地方小报社工作，”他说。

rag.en: We started out with a little rag-tag team of 30 people.
rag.cn: 我们最初只是一支由30人组成的散兵游勇的队伍。

rage.en: I saw her in a towering rage only once.
rage.cn: 我只有一次见过她大发雷霆。

rage.en: The rage in his eyes made her blood run cold.
rage.cn: 他眼中的怒火吓得她汗毛倒竖。

rage.en: Our father's face had reddened with rage and he began to sputter.
rage.cn: 我们的父亲气得涨红了脸，说话开始语无伦次。

rail.en: The sudden onset of winter caused havoc with rail and air transport.
rail.cn: 冬天的突然降临让铁路和航空运输系统陷入混乱。

rail.en: The rail strike is causing major disruptions at the country's ports.
rail.cn: 铁路罢工使该国港口陷入了一片混乱。

rail.en: The government is spending billions of dollars on new urban rail projects.
rail.cn: 政府正把数十亿元花在新城市铁路项目上。

railhead.en: The goods will be sent to the railhead by lorry.
railhead.cn: 货物将由货车运送到铁路终点。

railhead.en: The goods will be send to the railhead by lorry.
railhead.cn: 货物将由货车运送到铁路终点.

railhead.en: Several days later five of us traveled stern - wheel riverboat, to another railhead.
railhead.cn: 几天后,我们五个人乘坐小船到另外一个车站去.

railroad.en: Bridges over railroad tracks root danger out in crossing.
railroad.cn: 铁轨上空的天桥排除了穿行中的危险.

railroad.en: This town got a lot bigger when the railroad came in the 1860s.
railroad.cn: 自从19世纪60年代通了火车之后，这座城镇变大了许多。

railroad.en: The railroad finally reached Santa Barbara in 1877.
railroad.cn: 铁路终于在1877年修到了圣巴巴拉。

railway.en: The railway station smelt powerfully of cats and drains.
railway.cn: 火车站上有冲鼻的猫味和臭水沟味。

railway.en: Across the river the railway track ran up to the pithead.
railway.cn: 铁轨跨过这条河直达矿井口。

railway.en: Dozens of miles of railway track have been torn up.
railway.cn: 好几十英里的铁轨被毁坏了。

rain.en: She was born in the middle of a rain storm.
rain.cn: 她出生在一场暴风雨中。

rain.en: The recent rain had churned up the waterfall into a muddy whirlpool.
rain.cn: 最近的一场雨把瀑布搅成了泥水漩涡。

rain.en: He stared at the rain spattering on the glass.
rain.cn: 他凝视着雨点溅落在玻璃上。

rainbow.en: The moon was casting a rainbow through the spray from the waterfall.
rainbow.cn: 月亮在瀑布溅起的水雾上照出了一道彩虹。

rainbow.en: The Rainbow has not hosted live music since the end of 1981.
rainbow.cn: 1981年末之后，彩虹剧院就再没主办过现场音乐会。

raindrop.en: The raindrop whispered to the jasmine, " Keep me in your heart for ever. "
raindrop.cn: 雨点向茉莉花微语道: “ 把我永久地留在你的心里吧. ”

raindrop.en: The raindrop was beating against the windowpanes.
Gravity is pulling every raindrop and snowflake and hailstone.
raindrop.cn: 地心引力在吸引着每一个雨点,每一片雪花和每一块冰雹.

rainfall.en: Victoria Falls has had above average levels of rainfall this year.
rainfall.cn: 维多利亚瀑布今年的降雨量超过了平均水平。

rainfall.en: There have been four years of below average rainfall.
rainfall.cn: 已经有4年降雨量低于平均值了。

rainfall.en: Rainfall had dislodged debris from the slopes of the volcano.
rainfall.cn: 雨水冲走了火山坡面上的岩屑。

rainy.en: I'll put the rest in the bank for a rainy day.
rainy.cn: 我要把余款存入银行以备不时之需。

rainy.en: They walked along the promenade on a rainy night.
rainy.cn: 他们在一个雨夜沿着海滨道散步。

rainy.en: The rainy season in the Andes normally starts in December.
rainy.cn: 安第斯山区的雨季通常在12月份来临。

raise.en: The organisers hope to raise as much as £6m for charity.
raise.cn: 组织者希望能募集到高达600万英镑的善款。

raise.en: It seemed like a good neighbourhood to raise my children.
raise.cn: 它看起来像是一个有利于我的孩子们成长的理想居住区。

raise.en: Every year we have charity days to raise money for unfortunate people.
raise.cn: 每年我们都有慈善日来筹款帮助贫困人群。

raisin.en: I bought some lovely raisin buns at the bakery. Shall I bring you one with some tea?
raisin.cn: 我在面包店里买了些很好吃的葡萄干圆面包，要不要我给你拿一个，再来点儿茶？

raisin.en: Ingredient: Apple, lemon grass, orange pericarp, spice, hip pericarp, raisin, hibiscus.
raisin.cn: 成份: 苹果 、 柠檬草 、 柑橘皮 、 香料 、 蔷薇果皮 、 葡萄干 、 芙蓉(木槿).

raisin.en: " Here's a bit of raisin bread for you; eat it tomorrow.
raisin.cn: “ 这一包是葡萄浆的面包,请你收藏着, 明天好吃的.

rake.en: Nobody wanted to rake over his past history.
Rake the soil, press the seed into it, then cover it lightly.
rake.cn: 将土耙松，把种子种在土里，然后轻轻地盖上土。

rake.en: The privatisation allowed companies to rake in huge profits.
rake.cn: 私有化使许多公司大赚了一笔。

rally.en: We were very keen when the 1954 Rally came round.
rally.cn: 1954年的集会开始时，我们都非常热切。

rally.en: The immediate flashpoint was Wednesday's big rally in the city centre.
rally.cn: 星期三市中心的大集会成了直接的导火索。

rally.en: The rally was organised at the instance of two senior cabinet ministers.
rally.cn: 集会是应两位资深内阁大臣的要求组织的。

ramble.en: This is the best season for a ramble in the suburbs.
ramble.cn: 这是去郊区漫游的最好季节.

ramble.en: It would have been best written in a more concise way as it does tend to ramble.
ramble.cn: 它的行文确实有些信马由缰，要是简洁一些就好了。

ramble.en: By the end of May he began to ramble.
ramble.cn: 到了五月底,他就开始有点东拉西扯.

rampant.en: Sickness was rampant in the rural areas of this country.
rampant.cn: 这个国家的农村地区疾病流行.

rampant.en: That area is full of rampant lawlessness.
rampant.cn: 那个地区充斥着犯罪事件.

rampant.en: Unemployment is now rampant in most of Europe.
rampant.cn: 在欧洲的大部分地区，失业问题难以控制。

ranch.en: The ranch is in the middle of a large plateau.
ranch.cn: 该牧场位于一个辽阔高原的中部.

ranch.en: They had to buy everything at inflated prices at the ranch store.
ranch.cn: 他们不得不在农场商店以高价购买所有东西。

ranch.en: He left his Montana ranch to his spinster sister.
ranch.cn: 他把他在蒙大拿州的大牧场留给了他未婚的妹妹.

rancher.en: One rancher after another delivered himself of a torrent of furious words.
rancher.cn: 农庄主人们一个接一个的发表一段放连珠炮似的气势汹汹的讲话.

rancher.en: The rancher wants us to Bring in more hay for his cattle.
rancher.cn: 牧场主人希望我们为他的牲口带来更多的干草.

rancher.en: The rancher must always be on guard against the dangers that nature can create.
rancher.cn: 牧场主必须时刻防备可能发生的自然灾害.

rancho.en: He recently retired as Vice - president of the Eisenhower Medical Center Foundation in Rancho Mirage, California.
rancho.cn: 前不久他从加州RanchoMirage艾森豪医学中心基金的副总裁职务退休.

rancho.en: The township of Rio Rancho has hitherto not had its own emergency facilities.
rancho.cn: “里奥兰翘镇”迄今还没有自己的应急设施.

rancho.en: Shiva Moradfar of Rancho Santa Fe believes her home escaped the fire.
rancho.cn: 圣达菲的希佛相信,他的家逃过一劫.

rancorous.en: His speech was a bilious, rancorous attack on young people.
rancorous.cn: 他的讲话是对年轻人满怀敌意的狂暴攻击。

rancorous.en: The deal ended after a series of rancorous disputes.
rancorous.cn: 经过一连串充满敌意的争吵，交易泡汤了。

rancorous.en: He had long since wearied of discussing the rancorous subject.
rancorous.cn: 他早就厌倦这类怨气冲冲的话题了.

random.en: Any decent shot with telescopic sights could pick us off at random.
random.cn: 任何借助望远镜瞄准器的像样射手都可以随意把我们逐个干掉。

random.en: We received several answers, and we picked one at random.
random.cn: 我们收到了一些答复，并从中随机挑选了一个。

random.en: Three people were killed by shots fired at random from a minibus.
random.cn: 3个人被从一辆面包车中发射的乱弹打死了。

randomly.en: The eight chromosomes were randomly distributed at metaphase I.
randomly.cn: 在中期Ⅰ8对染色体的分布是无秩序的.

randomly.en: Transformed cells are loosely attached, rounded and randomly oriented.
randomly.cn: 转化细胞则不大贴壁 、 圆缩并呈杂乱分布.

randomly.en: Within the hot gas chamber, molecules are moving randomly in all directions.
randomly.cn: 在灼热的气体燃烧室内, 分子在各个方向上作无规运动.

range.en: The shooting-range is lit from underneath by rows of ruby-red light fittings.
range.cn: 射击场被一排排深红色的灯光设备从下面照亮了.

range.en: The company manufactures a range of innovative light-weight cycles.
range.cn: 这家公司生产一系列的新型轻便自行车。

range.en: They shot him at point blank range with an automatic rifle.
range.cn: 他们用自动步枪近距离开枪射杀了他。

rank.en: Substantial numbers of rank and file members ignored their union's advice.
rank.cn: 有相当一部分普通员工不理睬工会的建议。

rank.en: There was widespread support for him among the rank and file.
rank.cn: 那些普通职员们都普遍支持他。

rank.en: Dense smoke swirled and billowed, its rank fumes choking her.
rank.cn: 滚滚浓烟盘旋翻腾，恶臭味呛得她喘不过气来。

rap.en: Britain gave them a diplomatic rap over the knuckles.
rap.cn: 英国对他们进行了外交上的谴责。

rap.en: The rap on this guy is that he doesn't really care.
rap.cn: 这家伙据说并不怎么在乎。

rap.en: He said statisticians gave them a bad rap by "lying with figures".
rap.cn: 他说统计学家“用数据说谎”，败坏了他们的名声。

rape.en: It is an unpalatable fact that rape makes a good news story.
rape.cn: 强奸事件成了新闻报道的好素材，真是令人难以接受。

rape.en: Her party opposes abortion, except in cases of rape or incest.
rape.cn: 她的党派反对堕胎，但强奸或乱伦引起的怀孕除外。

rape.en: Most rape victims confess a feeling of helplessness.
rape.cn: 大部分强奸案受害者都承认有一种无助的感觉。

rapid.en: Two rapid transit trains collided early this morning in Boston.
rapid.cn: 今晨早些时候，两辆高速火车在波士顿相撞。

rapid.en: Leonard made a rapid calculation: he'd never make it in time.
rapid.cn: 伦纳德快速盘算了一下：他肯定赶不上了。

rapid.en: The company made a rapid-fire series of settlements with 25 States.
rapid.cn: 公司同25个州进行了一连串迅速的结算。

rapidity.en: The styles change with bewildering rapidity.
rapidity.cn: 风格多变,令人应接不暇.

rapidity.en: Animal and vegetable pests spread with extreme rapidity.
The water rushed through the holes with great rapidity.
rapidity.cn: 湍急的水流奔涌过洞口。

rapidly.en: These ideas rapidly became the new orthodoxy in linguistics.
rapidly.cn: 这些观点迅速成为语言学中新的正统观念。

rapidly.en: The vegetarian burger was an innovation which was rapidly exported to Britain.
rapidly.cn: 素食汉堡是一种迅速传到了英国的新开发食品。

rapidly.en: The film opened to healthy box office receipts before rapidly falling off.
rapidly.cn: 这部影片的票房收入开始的时候持续上涨，但是后来急剧下降。

rapport.en: He said he wanted "to establish a rapport with the Indian people"
rapport.cn: 他说他想“同印度人民建立友好关系”。

rapport.en: She has an excellent rapport with her staff.
rapport.cn: 她跟她职员的关系非常融洽.

rapport.en: She understood the importance of establishing a close rapport with clients.
rapport.cn: 她懂得与客户建立密切和谐的关系的重要性。

rapture.en: The film was shown to gasps of rapture at the Democratic Convention.
rapture.cn: 在民主党大会上放映的电影使人们十分欣喜。

rapture.en: What joy, what rapture, what glory to see him again!
rapture.cn: 再见到他是多么高兴、多么欢欣、多么美妙的事啊！

rapture.en: I stare in rapture at the ball.

rare.en: As we approached the summit we were vouchsafed a rare vision.
rare.cn: 快到山顶时，我们有幸看到了难得一见的景象。

rare.en: It remained an exceptionally rare book until it was reprinted in 1918.
rare.cn: 在1918年再版之前，这本书一直非常罕见。

rare.en: It was a rare pleasure to see him in action.

rarely.en: His face and movements rarely betrayed a sign of nerves.
rarely.cn: 他的表情和行为几乎没有流露出紧张的迹象。

rarely.en: Adolescent suicide is rarely an impulsive reaction to immediate distress.
rarely.cn: 青少年自杀很少是由于突然发生不幸而作出的冲动反应。

rarely.en: A spoilt child is rarely popular with other children.
rarely.cn: 被宠坏的孩子很难得到其他孩子的喜爱。

rarer.en: The results show that rarer variants are distributed more unevenly among populations.
rarer.cn: 本研究结果显示:越罕见的变体,其在人群中的分布也越不均衡.

rarer.en: There is something that is much more scarce, something rarer than ability.
rarer.cn: 有的东西比才能稀罕得多,珍贵得多, 这就是识别的能力.

rarer.en: Fortunately, such cowboy firms are becoming rarer.
rarer.cn: 幸运的是，这样的欺诈公司越来越少了。

rarity.en: It was a real prize due to its rarity and good condition.
rarity.cn: 因为稀有并且品相完好，它价值连城。

rarity.en: Sontag has always been that rarity, a glamorous intellectual.
rarity.cn: 桑塔格一直是那种兼具美貌与智慧的人中龙凤。

rarity.en: Flowering plants were making their first appearance, but were still a rarity.
rarity.cn: 显花植物开始出现了，但仍然很少。

rascal.en: Then a voice bawled: "Lay off! I'll kill you, you little rascal!"
rascal.cn: 然后一个声音大叫道：“赶紧停下！我会杀了你的，你这个小流氓！”

rascal.en: He's a nice old rascal but a disaster area as a politician.
rascal.cn: 他是个不错的老家伙，但是作为一个政治家就太差劲了。

rash.en: He may break out in a rash when he eats these nuts.
rash.cn: 他吃了这些坚果可能会长皮疹。

rash.en: Don't do anything rash until the feel-ings subside.
rash.cn: 在冷静下来之前不要鲁莽行事。

rash.en: Mr. Major is making no rash promises.
rash.cn: 梅杰先生没有作出轻率的承诺。

ratchet.en: He fears inflation will ratchet up as the year ends.
ratchet.cn: 他害怕通货膨胀会在年终更加严重。

ratchet.en: The chair has a ratchet below it to adjust the height.
ratchet.cn: 这把椅子下面有棘轮调整高度。

ratchet.en: A ratchet mechanism transfers the thread from spool to bobbin.
ratchet.cn: 一种棘齿装置把线从线轴转到梭心上。

rate.en: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.
rate.cn: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。

rate.en: The rate of inflation is running at about 2.7 percent.
He is the least appealing character, to me at any rate.
rate.cn: 他是其中最没有吸引力的角色，至少对我来说是这样。

rather.en: The process is not a circle but rather a spiral.
rather.cn: 这个过程不是一个圆周运动而是螺旋上升型的。

rather.en: I gradually got rather disillusioned with the whole setup of the university.
rather.cn: 渐渐地，我对大学的整个体制感到相当失望。

rather.en: Rather taken aback by such forwardness, I slammed down the phone.
rather.cn: 如此无礼的言语让我火冒三丈，我砰的一下把电话挂了。

ratify.en: The heads of two governments met to ratify the peace treaty.
ratify.cn: 两国政府首脑会晤批准和平条约.

ratify.en: The parliaments of Australia and Indonesia have yet to ratify the treaty.
ratify.cn: 澳大利亚和印度尼西亚的国会尚未批准该条约。

ratify.en: The government of Honduras refused to ratify the convention.
ratify.cn: 洪都拉斯政府拒不批准该约.

rating.en: The president's approval rating had risen.
Four restaurants have been awarded the highest accolade of a three - star rating .
rating.cn: 四家餐馆获授予 三星级 餐馆的最高荣誉称号.

rating.en: It is a ship with a rating of 500, 000 tons.
rating.cn: 这是一艘五十万吨级的船.

ratio.en: In 1978 there were 884 students at a lecturer/student ratio of 1:15.
The adult to child ratio is 1 to 6.
ratio.cn: 成人与儿童的比例为1比6。

ratio.en: What is the ratio of men to women in the department?
ratio.cn: 这个部门的男女比例是多少？

ration.en: We all had to queue up for our ration books.
ration.cn: 我们都得排队领取定量配给票证薄。

ration.en: The meat ration was down to one pound per person per week.
ration.cn: 肉的配给量降到了每人每周一磅。

ration.en: The authorities have begun to issue ration cards.
ration.cn: 当局已经开始发放定量配给卡。

rationalism.en: Rationalism usually considers itself more religious than empiricism.
rationalism.cn: 理性主义总以为自己比经验主义更有宗教信仰.

resilience.cn: 她对压力表现出了极大的适应能力.

resilience.en: There is no resilience to the body , hence it could relieve tiredness .
resilience.cn: 对人体无弹力，从而易于减缓疲劳感。

resilient.en: George Fraser was clearly a good soldier, calm and resilient.
resilient.cn: 乔治·弗雷泽显然是个好士兵，沉着冷静且适应力强。

resilient.en: Camels are among the most physiologically resilient creatures on Earth.
resilient.cn: 骆驼是地球上生理适应能力最强的生物之一。

resilient.en: He'll get over it—young people are amazingly resilient.
resilient.cn: 他会克服这些的—年轻人的适应力惊人。

resin.en: Two of the lorries, carrying industrial resin and paint thinner, burst into flames.
resin.cn: 其中运载工业树脂和涂料稀释剂的两辆卡车起火了。

resin.en: The resin from which the oil is extracted comes from a small, tough tree.
resin.cn: 用于提取这种油的树脂取自于一种矮小坚韧的树。

resist.en: I cannot resist slipping in a word of advice.
resist.cn: 我忍不住想插上一句建议。

resist.en: I only resist things like chocolate if I feel really gross.
resist.cn: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。

resist.en: In her place I wouldn't have been able to resist it.
resist.cn: 如果我是她就可能抗拒不了。

resistance.en: Such a policy would inevitably draw fierce resistance from farmers.
resistance.cn: 这种政策必然会招致农场主的强烈抵制。

resistance.en: In the end the Kurds surrendered without putting up any resistance.
resistance.cn: 最后库尔德人没有作任何抵抗就投降了。

resistance.en: Generally speaking there was no resistance to the idea.
resistance.cn: 一般说来，没有人会反对这个观点。

resistant.en: The majority have a built-in Luddite mentality; they are resistant to change.
resistant.cn: 大部分人天生有种反对技术进步的心理。他们抗拒变革。

resistant.en: The durable high-impact plastic case is water resistant to 100 feet.
resistant.cn: 这种结实的高强度塑料盒子在水下100英尺以内是防水的。

resistant.en: The body may be less resistant if it is cold.
resistant.cn: 天冷时，身体的抵抗力会下降。

resolute.en: He described the situation as very dangerous and called for resolute action.
resolute.cn: 他将形势描述得非常危险，并号召采取果断行动。

resolute.en: Voters perceive him as a decisive and resolute international leader.
resolute.cn: 投票者认为他是一位坚定果断的国际领导人。

resolute.en: He became even more resolute in his opposition to the plan.
resolute.cn: 他更加坚决地反对这个计划。

resolution.en: Today's Security Council resolution will be a significant success for American diplomacy.
resolution.cn: 今天的安理会决议将是美国外交取得的一个重大成功。

resolution.en: "I think I'll try a hypnotist," I said with sudden resolution.
resolution.cn: “我会找催眠师试试，”我突然坚决地说。

resolution.en: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent.
resolution.cn: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

resolve.en: This merely strengthens our resolve to win the league.
resolve.cn: 这只会更加坚定我们赢得联赛的决心。

resolve.en: The two communities are learning how to resolve their differences.
resolve.cn: 这两个社群正在学着如何解决彼此之间的分歧。

resolve.en: The two sides are now working diligently to resolve their differences.
resolve.cn: 双方正进行不懈的努力以解决他们之间的分歧。

resonance.en: Playing the piano sets up resonance in those glass ornaments.
resonance.cn: 一弹钢琴那些玻璃饰物就会产生共振.

resonance.en: His voice had lost its resonance; it was tense and strained.
resonance.cn: 他的声音不再洪亮，而是显得紧张，不太自然。

resonance.en: Her voice had a strange and thrilling resonance.
resonance.cn: 她的声音洪亮，有一种奇特的震撼人心的效果。

resonator.en: Some form of resonator may be used to dissipate energy in an oscillating feed system.
resonator.cn: 某些形式的谐振器可用来耗散供应系统内的振荡能量.

resonator.en: Using an Anti - resonant - Ring ( ARR ) structure, a plane - ARR colliding resonator Q - switched laser was designed.
resonator.cn: 引入抗共振环ARR( Anti—ResonantRing ) 结构, 设计了平-ARR对撞脉冲调Q激光器.

resonator.en: Resonator in thermoacoustic engine system is always used to adjust the frequency.
resonator.cn: 在热声发动机系统中,谐振管用来调节系统的超振频率.

resort.en: For a beach resort with a difference, try Key West.
resort.cn: 如果想去一个与众不同的海滨度假胜地，那就去基韦斯特吧。

resort.en: They would in the last resort support their friends whatever they did.
resort.cn: 无论他们的朋友做了什么，他们最终都会支持他们的朋友。

resort.en: The resort is surrounded by extensive national and regional parklands.
resort.cn: 那个度假胜地被广阔的国家和地区绿地所环绕。

resource.en: All pollution is simply an unused resource.
resource.cn: 所有的污染只不过是一种未被利用的资源.

resource.en: Water is becoming an increasingly precious resource.
resource.cn: 水正成为日益珍贵的资源。

resource.en: A country's principal resource is its brainpower.
resource.cn: 一个国家的首要资源是其人才资源。

resourceful.en: What is immediately striking is how resourceful the children are.
resourceful.cn: 最令人注目的是孩子们的机智聪明.

resourceful.en: He is very clever and endlessly resourceful.

resourcefulness.en: He marveled sometimes at the man's resourcefulness.
resourcefulness.cn: 他有时对于这个人的足智多谋感到吃惊.

resourcefulness.en: Once he was launched on a course, Nixon's determination was equal to his tactical resourcefulness.
resourcefulness.cn: 尼克松一旦开始执行一项方针, 他的决心之大同他的多谋善断是不相上下的.

resourcefulness.en: Because of his adventures, he is a person of far greater experience and resourcefulness.
resourcefulness.cn: 诸多冒险经历使他的经验和智谋都要比别人高出一筹。

respect.en: I respect his judgement and I'll follow any advice he gives me.
respect.cn: 我尊重他的判断能力，会接受他提出的任何建议。

respect.en: The treaty binds them to respect their neighbour's independence.
respect.cn: 条约规定他们必须尊重其邻国的独立。

respect.en: We need to restore respect for the law-enforcement agencies.
respect.cn: 我们需要重塑执法机构的声望。

respectable.en: He was now a teacher and a respectable member of the community.
respectable.cn: 他现在是一位教师，并且是社区内受人尊敬的一员。

respectable.en: I have to prove myself as a respectable, balanced, person.
respectable.cn: 我必须证明自己是个正派、稳重的人。

respectable.en: He depicted the town's respectable families in an unflattering light.
respectable.cn: 他在描述镇上体面人家时满是贬抑之词。

respective.en: The duo set up a scam to settle their respective debts.
respective.cn: 那对搭档设了一计以消除各自的债务。

respective.en: Steve and I were at very different stages in our respective careers.
respective.cn: 史蒂夫和我在各自的职业生涯中处于迥然不同的阶段。

respective.en: It is important that we dovetail our respective interests.
respective.cn: 让我们各自的利益相吻合很重要。

respectively.en: Their sons, Ben and Jonathan, were three and six respectively.
respectively.cn: 他们的儿子，本和乔纳森，分别是3岁和6岁。

respectively.en: Metal, oil and soap contains foreign matter, respectively.
respectively.cn: 金属 、 油和肥皂中分别含有杂质.

respectively.en: Julie and Mark, aged 17 and 19 respectively
respectively.cn: 朱莉和马克，年龄分别为17岁和19岁

respiration.en: They made frequent checks on his respiration, pulse and blood.
respiration.cn: 他们经常检查他的呼吸 、 脉搏和血液.

respiration.en: She was given artificial respiration and cardiac massage.
respiration.cn: 有人给她做了人工呼吸和心脏按压。

respiration.en: Blood pressure and respiration are also recorded.
respiration.cn: 血压和呼吸也做了记录。

respond.en: We must respond to well-founded criticism with a willingness to change.
respond.cn: 对于有根有据的批评，我们必须乐意作出改变。

respond.en: Some cases of arthritis respond to a gluten-free diet.
respond.cn: 无麸质饮食对一些关节炎患者有疗效。

respond.en: Like any other public servants, police must respond to public demand.
respond.cn: 和其他所有公务员一样，警察必须服务于公众的需求。

respondent.en: In addition, the respondent disclosed professional confidences to one of the patients.
respondent.cn: 另外，被告还向其中一位病人透露了行业机密。

respondent.en: Both the petitioner and respondent provide for the upkeep of the children.
respondent.cn: 离婚上诉方和被告方共同抚养子女。

respondent.en: The respondent, Dayco , was an automobile parts manufacturer accused of price discrimination.
respondent.cn: 被告 戴科 是一个汽车零件制造商,被控进行价格差别待遇.

response.en: The agency was heavily criticised for its tardy response to the hurricane.
response.cn: 该机构因对飓风反应迟缓，受到严厉批评。

response.en: His response to attacks on his work was chiefly bewilderment.
response.cn: 听到别人对自己工作的指责，他的反应主要是困惑。

response.en: I'm depressed by the bovine enthusiasm of the crowd's response.
response.cn: 人群毫无热情的迟钝反应使我感到很沮丧。

responsibility.en: Carrington held a position of responsibility within the government.
responsibility.cn: 卡林顿在政府机构身居要职。

responsibility.en: He wants companies to follow the European model of social responsibility.
responsibility.cn: 他希望各公司能够以欧洲公司为榜样，承担社会责任。

responsibility.en: Responsibility and moderation were to be the keynotes of their foreign policy.
responsibility.cn: 责任和克制将是他们外交政策的核心。

responsive.en: Harriet was an easy, responsive little girl.
responsive.cn: 哈丽雅特是一个随和机灵的小女孩。

responsive.en: Three months before birth babies are already responsive to sound.
responsive.cn: 在出生前3个月，胎儿就已经对声音有反应了。

responsive.en: Burke's sentiments undoubtedly struck a responsive chord in Parliament.
responsive.cn: 伯克的观点无疑引起了议会的积极回应。

rest.en: He wolfed down the rest of the biscuit and cheese.
rest.cn: 他把剩下的饼干和奶酪一扫而光。

rest.en: When you are sitting, keep your elbow on the arm rest.
rest.cn: 坐立时，把胳膊肘靠在扶手上。

rest.en: The price of oil should remain stable for the rest of 1992.
rest.cn: 油价会在1992年剩下的时间里保持稳定。

restatement.en: Mr Prescott concentrated on offering a classic restatement of Labour values.
restatement.cn: 普雷斯科特先生专注于对工党价值观进行经典的阐释。

restatement.en: I hope this book is not yet another restatement of the prevailing wisdom.
restatement.cn: 我希望这本书不会又是重复一些流行的至理名言。

restatement.en: Thus, fault plays a role in the Restatement assessment.
restatement.cn: 所以, 在重审估价中,缺陷也起着一定作用.

restaurant.en: We had lunch the other day at our favorite restaurant.
restaurant.cn: 前两天我们在最喜欢的餐馆吃了午饭。

restaurant.en: They ate in an Italian restaurant in Forth Street.
restaurant.cn: 他们在第四大街的一家意大利餐馆吃了饭。

restaurant.en: He insisted we stop at a small restaurant just outside of Atlanta.
restaurant.cn: 他坚持让我们在亚特兰大市外不远的一家小餐馆歇歇脚。

restful.en: After a joyous and restful three days, I left this beautiful city.
restful.cn: 度过了愉快轻松的3天后，我离开了这个美丽的城市。

restful.en: Adjust the lighting so it is soft and restful.
restful.cn: 调节灯光使其看上去既柔和又能给人带来舒缓感。

restful.en: It's so restful to meander along Irish country roads.
restful.cn: 沿着爱尔兰的乡间小路漫步是多么惬意。

restless.en: He felt restless and dissatisfied as he drove home.
restless.cn: 在开车回家的途中，他感到烦躁不安，很不高兴。

restless.en: The unity of our society is threatened by troublesome and restless minorities.
restless.cn: 我们社会的团结遭到了一小撮滋扰生事、不安分守己的群体的威胁。

restless.en: Marian retains a restless, youthful spirit, in search of new horizons.
restless.cn: 玛丽安怀着一颗年轻、不断进取的心去寻求新的天地。

restock.en: I have to restock the freezer.
restock.cn: 我得往冰箱里再放点东西。

restock.en: When the item sells the suppliers can restock it.
restock.cn: 商品卖出后供货商就会再进货.

restock.en: And if you restock the shelves , they will steal it again.
restock.cn: 如果你再度存储, 他们会再盗一次.

restoration.en: His visit is expected to lead to the restoration of diplomatic relations.
restoration.cn: 人们期待他的出访会恢复外交关系。

restoration.en: The restoration took almost 4,000 man-hours over four years.
restoration.cn: 修复工作历时4年，耗费近4,000工时。

restoration.en: They were committed to the eventual restoration of a traditional monarchy.
restoration.cn: 他们致力于传统君主政体的最终恢复。

restrain.en: Unable to restrain herself, she rose and went to the phone.
restrain.cn: 她没能克制住自己，起身走向电话。

restrain.en: If you can't restrain your dog you must lock it up.
restrain.cn: 如果你无法管住你的狗,就必须把它关起来.

restrain.en: In the 1970s, the government tried to restrain corruption.
restrain.cn: 在20世纪70年代，政府曾经试图打击腐败。

restraint.en: He sued them for restraint of trade and won.
restraint.cn: 他控告他们实行贸易管制，并且胜诉了。

restraint.en: The old sense of deference and restraint in royal reporting has vanished.
restraint.cn: 在对皇室进行的新闻报道中，那种由来已久的尊重和收敛意识已经消失了。

restraint.en: Gandhi exemplified the virtues of renunciation, asceticism and restraint.
restraint.cn: 甘地体现了克己、禁欲和自我约束的美德。

restrict.en: The hospital may restrict bookings to people living locally.
restrict.cn: 这家医院可能会限定只有当地居民才能预约。

restrict.en: He feels this new law will restrict his freedom.
restrict.cn: 他觉得这一新法律会限制他的自由.

restrict.en: Villagers say the fence would restrict public access to the hills.
restrict.cn: 村民们说这个围栏将限制公众进入山区。

restrictive.cn: 转换生成语法局限性更大。

restrictive.en: The Act was introduced to end restrictive practices in the docks.
restrictive.cn: 这项法案的推出是为了终止码头的限制竞争现象。

restructure.en: The business establishment is terminated due to the restructure or ownership transfer.
restructure.cn: 二事业单位改组或转让,致事业单位消灭者.

restructure.en: How can I begin to restructure my life so that I'm happier with it?
restructure.cn: 我怎样才能开始调整自己的生活，让自己更快乐一些？

restructure.en: The President called on educators and politicians to help him restructure American education.
restructure.cn: 总统号召教育家和政治家们帮助他重新调整美国的教育体系。

result.en: Receding gums can be the result of disease or simply incorrect brushing.
result.cn: 牙龈萎缩可能是疾病导致的，也可能仅仅是错误的刷牙方式引起的。

result.en: Many motor accidents are the result of unthinkingly mixing speed and alcohol.
result.cn: 许多机动车事故都是不计后果地酒后开快车造成的。

result.en: The result reflects a modest rightward shift in opinion.
result.cn: 结果显示舆论出现一定程度的右倾。

resultant.en: At least a quarter of a million people have died in the fighting and the resultant famines.
resultant.cn: 至少25万人死于这场战斗和由此引发的饥荒。

resultant.en: The resultant material was to be pored over by experts in psychology.
resultant.cn: 这样的一份材料要由心理学专家精心研究.

resultant.en: the growing economic crisis and resultant unemployment
resultant.cn: 不断加剧的经济危机以及由此而产生的失业

resume.en: I was given the all clear by the doctor to resume playing.
resume.cn: 医生准许我重新开始训练。

resume.en: Within hours, she was free to resume her journey westward.
resume.cn: 几小时以后她便抽出身来重新开始西行的旅程。

resume.en: They thought that he should resume his kingly duties.
resume.cn: 他们认为他应该继续履行君主的职责。

retail.en: The news from Body Shop rattled the rest of the retail sector.
retail.cn: 从“美体小铺”传来的消息令整个零售行业不安。

retail.en: He now controls the largest retail development empire in southern California.
retail.cn: 他现在掌管着加州南部最大的零售发展企业。

retail.en: There's nothing better than a bit of retail therapy.
retail.cn: 没有什么比花钱买点东西能让自己高兴起来了。

retailer.en: It made it almost impossible for the smaller retailer to compete against the multiples.
retailer.cn: 这使得小零售商几乎不可能跟连锁店竞争。

retailer.en: Top retailer Marks & Spencer has romped in with another set of sparkling results.
retailer.cn: 零售巨头玛莎百货再次凭借一系列耀眼的成绩轻松胜出。

retailer.en: Take the goods back to your retailer who will refund you the purchase price.
retailer.cn: 把商品退还给你的零售商，他们会按原价退款的。

retain.en: Vegetables should retain some firmness and should not be soggy and waterlogged.
retain.cn: 蔬菜应保持一定的硬挺度，不应潮乎乎的浸透了水。

retain.en: Disney will retain a 51 percent controlling interest in the venture.
retain.cn: 迪斯尼将保留该项目51%的控股权。

retain.en: Daily facial exercises help her to retain the skin's elasticity.
retain.cn: 每天做面部运动帮助她保持皮肤弹性。

retard.en: Numerous and extensive eddy cavities retard the turbulent mixing process.
retard.cn: 多而大的涡流区延迟了扰动的混合过程.

retard.en: What the hell do I want with an emotional retard?
retard.cn: 和一个感情用事的傻瓜在一起，我究竟是图什么？

retard.en: Continuing violence will retard negotiations over the country's future.
retard.cn: 持续不断的暴力活动会阻碍关系到国家未来的谈判的进行。

retention.en: He argues strongly for retention of NATO as a guarantee of peace.
retention.cn: 他强烈要求保留北大西洋公约组织以维护和平。

retention.en: They supported the retention of a strong central government.
retention.cn: 他们赞成保留一个强大的中央政府。

retention.en: The company needs to improve its training and retention of staff.
retention.cn: 公司需要改进对员工的培训和留用工作。

retentive.en: He has a very retentive memory.
He is a scholar who has wide learning and a retentive memory.
retentive.cn: 他是一位博闻强记的学者.

retentive.en: Luke had an amazingly retentive memory.

retire.en: The jury will retire to consider its verdict today.
retire.cn: 陪审团今天将退庭商议裁决结果。

retire.en: It would be nice to be able to afford to retire earlier.
retire.cn: 无后顾之忧而能提早退休当是件幸事。

retire.en: If they prove ineffective they should be demoted or asked to retire.
retire.cn: 如果事实证明他们已无力胜任，应该将他们降级或让他们退休。

retirement.en: The New York Times has this very laudatory article about your retirement.
retirement.cn: 《纽约时报》发文谈及你的隐退，文中对你大加赞扬。

retirement.en: The term "early retirement" is nearly always a euphemism for redundancy nowadays.
retirement.cn: 现在“提前退休”几乎就是裁员的委婉说法。

retirement.en: He spent the last fourteen years of his life in retirement.
retirement.cn: 他一生中最后的14年是在退休中度过的。

retool.en: In the computer industry, engineers have to retool frequently.
retool.cn: 在电脑业中, 工程师必须经常以新知识充实装备自己.

retool.en: We must retool the town's economy.
retool.cn: 我们必须对乡镇经济进行重组.

retort.cn: 她的反驳是脱口而出的。

retort.en: His sharp retort clearly made an impact.
retort.cn: 他尖刻的反驳显然起了作用。

retort.en: He scored a bull's - eye in their argument with that witty retort.
retort.cn: 在他们的辩论中他那一句机智的反驳击中了要害.

retract.en: A cat can retract its claws, but a dog can't.
retract.cn: 猫的爪子可以缩进去, 但狗不能.

retract.en: He's hoping that if he makes me feel guilty, I'll retract.
retract.cn: 他指望着如果他能让我感到内疚，我就会收回所说的话。

retract.cn: 撕裂的肌肉会收缩，丧失原来的力量、结构和紧实度。

retrain.en: Airlines would prefer to update rather than retrain crews.
retrain.cn: 航空公司更愿意换新员工而不是对旧员工重新进行培训。

retrain.en: Union leaders have called upon the government to help retrain workers.

ziggurat.en: The lightning zigzagged through the church yard.
ziggurat.cn: 闪电呈之字形划过教堂的院子.

ziggurat.en: The office buildings were slightly zigzagged to fit available ground space.
ziggurat.cn: 办公大楼为了配合可用的地皮建造得略呈之字形.

ziggurat.en: Expertly he zigzagged his way across the field, avoiding the deeper gullies.
ziggurat.cn: 他熟练地左一拐右一拐地绕过深沟，穿过了原野。

zinc.en: Tin compound was coated on the surface of the calcium zincate by chemical deposition.
zinc.cn: 采用化学沉积法在四边形锌酸钙表面包覆一层金属锡化合物.

zinc.en: The zinc - iron alloy electroplating technology in zincate solution by pulse current was investigated.
zinc.cn: 介绍了在锌酸盐溶液中脉冲电镀锌 - 铁合金工艺.

zinc.en: Improvement in alkaline etching and smut removing before zincate treatment was summed up.
zinc.cn: 对浸锌前处理的碱蚀和出光的改进方法进行了总结.

zirconium.en: The girl is playing the zither by the river.
zirconium.cn: 那个姑娘正在湖边抚琴.

zirconium.en: Lithe ribbon - dancers with zither - strumming and pipa - plucking ladies as backup? Done that.
zirconium.cn: 中国的杂技演员顶着瓷碗向后弯腰及地.

zirconium.en: Daming and Lingling can play the zither, too.
zirconium.cn: 大明和玲玲也会弹古筝.

zoologist.en: I would like to brush up my zoology.
zoologist.cn: 我想重新温习一下动物学.

zoologist.en: The library didn't stock zoology textbooks.
zoologist.cn: 这家图书馆没有动物学教科书.

space.en: We must make good use of the available space.
space.cn: 我们必须充分利用现有空间。

space.en: It is quite possible that space and time are finite.
space.cn: 很有可能空间和时间是有限的。

tiger.en: She'll fight like a tiger to protect her children.
tiger.cn: 她为了保护孩子，可以凶得像只老虎。
